new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**Quality Director**

**Aerospace Manufacturing | Senior Leadership Team**

**About Columbia Manufacturing**

Columbia Manufacturing, a member of Collective Manufacturing Group, produces complex fabricated components and assemblies for leading aerospace and power generation engine programs. We are committed to delivering safe, reliable, and compliant products while fostering a culture built on integrity, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Quality Director who will strengthen our quality culture, develop our people, and help ensure we remain a trusted partner to our customers.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is a member of the senior leadership team responsible for ensuring Columbia Manufacturing consistently delivers products that meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements.

This role goes beyond compliance. We are seeking a leader who combines sound judgment, ethical decision-making, objective interpretation of requirements, and strong cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will guide the organization through customer requirements, industry standards, and business challenges while ensuring quality and integrity remain at the center of every decision. We believe strong teams produce strong results, and cultural fit is as important as technical expertise.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who earns trust, develops people, and works effectively with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and customers. We value practical experience as highly as formal education and welcome candidates who have built their careers through hands-on manufacturing and quality leadership roles.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Quality Management System**

* Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and aerospace requirements.
* Promote quality ownership and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Guide Quality Decisions**

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, contractual requirements, and industry standards.
* Provide guidance when requirements are unclear, conflicting, or open to interpretation.
* Lead investigations, corrective actions, and nonconformance resolution using sound judgment and risk-based decision making.

**Partner with Customers and Regulatory Bodies**

* Serve as the primary quality representative to customers, auditors, and regulatory agencies.
* Build trusted relationships and lead internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**Develop People and Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Quality team.
* Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, and succession planning.
* Foster collaboration and an environment where employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Promote a culture where doing the right thing is always more important than meeting a schedule.

**Contribute to Business Success**

* Partner with Operations and Leadership to improve performance, reduce risk, strengthen organizational alignment, and support growth.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and compliance requirements without compromising quality standards.
* Exercise independent quality authority and be willing to stop production or shipment when requirements have not been met.

**What We’re Looking For**

We recognize that great leaders come from many backgrounds. Candidates may have developed through engineering, manufacturing, inspection, quality systems, operations, military service, trade programs, or traditional degree pathways. Equivalent combinations of education, military training, trade experience, and hands-on manufacturing or quality leadership experience will be fully considered.

We are less concerned with how you gained your experience and more interested in your ability to lead people, interpret requirements, make sound decisions, and uphold quality standards under pressure.

Successful candidates will typically possess:

* Experience leading quality functions within aerospace, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, customer requirements, and specification interpretation.
* Demonstrated ethical leadership, sound decision-making, and the ability to uphold standards under pressure.
* Proven success leading teams and collaborating across departments.
* Strong communication skills and experience working with customers, auditors, and senior leadership.
* Continuous improvement mindset and practical problem-solving ability.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with aerospace quality standards such as AS9100, AS9110, AS13100, NADCAP, or customer-specific requirements.
* Experience supporting OEM customers such as GE Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, or similar organizations.
* Quality certifications or advanced education are valued but not required.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Quality Director plays a critical role in protecting our customers, our employees, and our reputation. This leader helps ensure that every product we build meets requirements and that every decision we make reflects our commitment to integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you are a leader who values ethics, teamwork, sound judgment, and building strong people and processes, we encourage you to apply.**

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Job Summary:

### **Position Summary**

The Director of Quality is an execution-focused leader responsible for translating WellBe’s enterprise quality strategy into disciplined, measurable operations across markets and health plan contracts.

This role leads the day-to-day Quality function, manages and develops team members, and redesigns care-gap closure workflows to be simpler, standardized, scalable, and integrated into clinical practice.

The Director partners closely with market, clinical, pharmacy, analytics, technology, coding, and health plan stakeholders to improve HEDIS and Medicare Advantage Stars performance, strengthen data reliability, increase frontline accountability, and ensure the organization consistently converts quality insights into action.

Job Description:

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 
Lead day-to-day execution of the Quality program across Part C and Part D, converting enterprise goals into clear workplans, owners, timelines, operating rhythms, and measurable results. 
Directly manage, coach, and performance-manage Quality team members; establish clear productivity, quality, service, and accountability standards. 
Map end-to-end care-gap closure workflows across measures, markets, and health plan contracts; identify handoffs, rework, manual steps, failure points, and unnecessary variation. 
Redesign and standardize workflows so care-gap identification, outreach, documentation, closure, submission, and reconciliation are consistently executed and sustainable at scale. 
Engage Markets using structured working sessions that diagnose barriers, assign actions, monitor commitments, and drive closure at the patient, provider, measure, and market levels. 
Partner with clinical operations and technology teams to surface prioritized care gaps at the point of care and embed closure activities into APP workflows. 
Lead implementation and adoption of Quality workflow tools, including in-house technologies, point-of-care solutions, telephony or workforce-management tools, and future AI-enabled capabilities. 
Oversee HEDIS chart abstraction, primary source validation, medical record retrieval, supplemental data submissions, and health plan audit support, with an emphasis on accuracy, timeliness, and reduced manual effort. 
Manage medication adherence and other Part D outreach operations; use performance and workflow data to improve productivity, assess capacity, and inform staffing decisions. 
Partner with analytics, IT, and health plan teams to strengthen WellBe-owned quality reporting using claims, EMR, pharmacy, and supplemental data; reconcile numerator, denominator, timing, and data-integrity differences. 
Use market-, provider-, measure-, and patient-level data to prioritize interventions, forecast performance, monitor outcomes, and adjust tactics quickly when results are off track. 
Evaluate and implement practical automation and AI-assisted solutions that reduce repetitive work, improve chart-review efficiency, and allow the team to focus on higher-value intervention and market partnership. 
Own point-of-care solution assessment and implementation, including identification of operational pain points, vendor coordination, rollout planning, training, adoption, and performance monitoring. 
Maintain current knowledge of NCQA, HEDIS, CMS, Stars, and applicable health plan requirements; ensure workflows, documentation, submissions, and controls remain compliant. 
Build effective cross-functional relationships and drive decisions with stakeholders across clinical operations, pharmacy, coding, analytics, technology, finance, compliance, markets, and external vendors.

Job Requirements:

### **Required Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, public health, health sciences, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**Experience:** Seven or more years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, managed care, provider operations, population health, HEDIS, or Medicare Advantage Stars, including 3–5 years of people-management experience. Demonstrated experience setting expectations, coaching team members, managing performance, delivering measurable operational results, and mapping, redesigning, implementing, and sustaining complex workflows across multiple teams, markets, or contracts.

**Skills:** Strong working knowledge of NCQA HEDIS specifications, Medicare Advantage Stars, care-gap closure, medical record review, supplemental data, and quality operations. Proven ability to move between strategy and execution, manage multiple priorities, remove barriers, and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrixed organization. Strong people leadership, change-management, project-management, process-improvement, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and presentation tools; experience with workflow platforms, reporting tools, automation, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions preferred. High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

### **Physical and Mental Requirements**

* Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.
* Visual acuity and fine motor.
* Ability to travel locally or nationally as needed.

### **Work Environment**

This role operates in a corporate, primarily remote environment and requires frequent collaboration across functions, markets, and external partners. Occasional travel and schedule flexibility may be required to support market operations, implementations, audits, and business priorities. No routine on-call responsibilities are expected.

### **Sponsorship Statement**

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

### **Pay Transparency Statement**

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

### **Safety-Sensitive Statement**

This position has been designated as safety-sensitive. As such, the employee must be able to perform job duties in a manner that ensures the safety of themselves, coworkers, patients, and the public. The role requires full cognitive and physical functioning at all times.

Employees in safety-sensitive positions are subject to drug and alcohol testing, including for substances that may impair judgment or motor function, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws and company policy. Due to the safety-sensitive nature of this role and in alignment with federal law and workplace safety standards, the use of marijuana—including medical or recreational use—is prohibited. WellBe Senior Medical will comply with applicable state laws regarding medical marijuana and reasonable accommodations, where such laws do not conflict with safety requirements or federal regulations.

### **Drug Screening Requirement**

As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Ongoing employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform their job duties.

### **Background Check Statement**

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by law. As a healthcare organization, WellBe conducts monthly FACIS (Fraud and Abuse Control Information System) checks on all employees. Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of these checks, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

### **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement**

WellBe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

### **Americans with Disabilities Act**

WellBe Senior Medical is committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. If you require an accommodation during the application, interview or employment process, please contact Human Resources at HRPeopleLine@wellbe.com

### **At-Will Employment Statement**

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.

### **Disclaimer**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

**Job Title:** Director, Quality/Performance Improvement

**Company:** HealthAlliance Hospital

**City/State:** Kingston, NY

**Category:** Executive/Management

**Department:** Quality/Performance Improvement

**Union:** Yes

**Union Name:** N/A

**Position:** Full Time

**Hours:** 7.5

**Shift:** Day

**Req #:** 50089

**Posted Date:** Nov 11, 2026

**Hiring Range:** $160,013-$202,547

External Applicant link Internal Applicant link

\*If you are hired by WMCHealth, your final base salary will be determined based on job-related factors, including employment status (full-time, part-time or per diem), relevant skills, qualifications and experience. Consistent with our commitment to pay equity, we also consider internal equity among similarly situated employees when determining final compensation.

 

### **Job Details:**

JOB SUMMARY Working directly under the VP, Quality Management, provides oversight to designing and administering a comprehensive hospital wide Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement with focus on the Patient Experience that meets organization strategic objectives and improves patient outcomes and quality of care. RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for directing QA/QI Management activities by identifying areas of potential for improvement in quality, safety or other identified risks in accordance with the department and hospital mission. Directs the collection, measurement and presentation of data required for monitoring performance improvement and quality initiatives regardingpatient satisfaction and experience.Oversees and designs quality dashboards as appropriate Provides leadership to the Medical Staff in identification of quality and performance improvement opportunities based on department peer review activity and organization-wide quality initiatives data. Communicates and acts as a liaison with outside agencies such as CMS, IPRO,National Research Corporation or other appropriate agency as to ensure compliance with external reporting requirements and improvement initiatives. new_roles.title: Director of Quality and Informatics
new_roles.description:
### **Director of Quality and Informatics**

**Status:** Full-time **| Location:** Remote (AZ) w/ Occasional On-Site Presence in Tempe 
**Department:** Quality Management | **Reports To:** CMO 
**FLSA Status:** Exempt | **Pay Class:** Salary 
**Salary Range:** $79,793.00 - $105,455.00

SCHEDULE: 40 HOURS WEEKLY, MONDAY-FRIDAY

### **Position Summary**

The Director of Quality and Informatics plays a pivotal leadership role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality, data-informed behavioral healthcare services. This position is responsible for overseeing quality improvement initiatives, clinical data analysis, and informatics strategies that drive performance outcomes, enhance client care, and support regulatory compliance. The Director will lead their team in developing, implementing, and monitoring evidence-based practices, performance metrics, and data systems. This individual will play a pivotal role in driving population health outcomes across all service lines and advancing the organization's value-based care initiatives.This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong background in healthcare quality, informatics, and behavioral health operations who can bridge clinical excellence with data-driven decision-making.

At CPR, we are committed to making diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging an integral part of our daily operations. We strive to hire and retain talented, diverse, and creative individuals, and we are dedicated to ensuring equitable treatment by promoting fairness and respect at every level of our organization.

### **Knowledge and Skills**

* Experience in clinical quality management, regulatory compliance, and outcome measurement
* Proven leadership and team development skills across interdisciplinary teams
* Knowledge of federal and state regulations, including Board of Medical Facilities Licensing (BMFL), Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), as well as the standards for healthcare quality and compliance.
* Well developed understanding of best clinical practices and evidence -based treatment models for behavioral health
* Extensive knowledge of population health, value-based care models, and risk stratification
* Ability to analyze complex data to inform strategic decisions and drive improvement
* Strong project management and process improvement expertise
* Proficiency with healthcare IT systems (EHR, HIE, data integration)
* Excellent verbal and written communication for reporting and stakeholder engagement
* Understanding of Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) and their impact on health outcomes

### **Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead initiatives to enhance clinical quality, including process improvements, audits, and compliance with regulatory standards
* Manage technology systems to support quality improvement and clinical performance, including overseeing EHR optimization and data integration
* Oversee population health management programs, including monitoring and reporting on Value-Based Contracts (VBC) and shared savings agreements
* Collaborate with health plans and other stakeholders to develop and implement targeted interventions for improving patient outcomes and addressing SDOH
* Facilitate cross-functional meetings to ensure alignment with business goals, including regular reviews of VBC performance, quality metrics, and operational efficiencies
* Conduct data analysis and report on performance, outcomes, and opportunities for improvement across all departments
* Lead special projects to drive innovation and efficiency, including Targeted Investments (TI) and Data Analytics & Performance (DAP) initiatives
* Provide oversight of client satisfaction surveys and ensure continuous feedback loops to improve service delivery
* Develop and maintain key strategic partnerships to ensure the success of population health initiatives, with a focus on behavioral health integration
* Provide departmental leadership and supervision to direct reports, including performance management, coaching, hiring, and training
* Manage the department’s budget, resources, and operational strategies to support departmental goals.
* Reliable and predictable attendance is an essential job function.
* Other duties as assigned

### **Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Healthcare Administration, or related field required.
* Minimum of 2 years in a management or supervisory role in behavioral health or healthcare required.
* Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred but not required.
* Current, unrestricted license issued by the Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners: LCSW (Licensed Clinical Social Worker), LPC (Licensed Professional Counselor), Ph.D (Doctor of Philosophy), Psy.D (Doctor of Psychology) preferred but not required.

### **Other Requirements**

* Provide evidence of professional liability insurance coverage in the amount acceptable, minimum $1/$3 million.
* Must comply with training and supervision requirements during first 90 days of employment, and throughout employment.
* All licensed, certified, and registered staff will be monitored regarding restrictions.
* Appropriate reference checks by letter and telephone as requested.
* State-required background check.
* Medicare/Medicaid sanctions, criminal violations, subsequent malpractice actions, and any settlement(s) made on behalf of practitioners.
* Within seven (7) days of hire, apply for and/or present and maintain a Class One Fingerprint Clearance card. If application is necessary, a copy must be submitted for inclusion in the personnel file until card (and/or renewals) is received.
* All required renewals must be submitted 30 days prior to expiration date. It is the duty of the licensee to keep all renewals active and current and report any mandated changes to Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners immediately.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality Management
new_roles.description:
The Massachusetts Department of Mental Health (DMH) is seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Quality Management to lead quality improvement, performance monitoring, and risk management efforts across its Northeast Area (NEA). DMH is committed to improving the lives of individuals with mental health needs by providing access to quality treatment, rehabilitation, and community-based services that support recovery, independence, and well-being. In this important leadership role, you will help ensure that programs and services consistently meet established standards of care while identifying opportunities to strengthen service delivery and improve outcomes for the individuals and families served. Working closely with Area leadership, clinical professionals, and community providers, you will help establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and responsive, person-centered care.

As the Director of Quality Management, you will oversee a broad range of quality assurance, performance improvement, utilization management, and risk management activities that directly influence the effectiveness of mental health services throughout the Northeast Area. You will lead a team of professionals, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and use data, investigations, and performance evaluations to guide meaningful improvements in service quality and organizational operations. This position offers an opportunity to influence policies and practices, address complex operational challenges, and contribute to strategic decisions that strengthen the delivery of mental health services. The selected candidate will play an essential role in ensuring that DMH programs remain responsive to the needs of the communities they serve while advancing the Department's commitment to high-quality, accessible, and effective mental health care across the Commonwealth.

***Duties and Responsibilities (these duties are a general summary and not all inclusive):***

* Develop, implement, and oversee comprehensive quality management programs and performance improvement initiatives designed to strengthen service delivery, improve client outcomes, and enhance organizational effectiveness across the Northeast Area.

* Lead the monitoring and evaluation of Area-funded programs and contracted providers to assess service quality, identify performance concerns, and ensure adherence to established standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.

* Direct the review and analysis of critical incidents, complaints, and service delivery concerns, ensuring appropriate fact-finding activities, timely responses, and implementation of corrective actions.

* Coordinate contract monitoring and performance review activities for community-based services, including Adult Community Clinical Services (ACCS), to evaluate provider performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

* Establish quality management priorities, performance measures, and reporting processes to assess organizational progress, identify trends, and support informed management decisions.

* Oversee risk management activities, including identifying potential service delivery risks, evaluating organizational vulnerabilities, and recommending preventive and corrective measures.

* Support the Performance Improvement and Corrective Action Planning activities, including identifying performance issues, supporting PIP and CAP development by providers, and monitoring progress. Participate in identifying escalation protocols and support communication and planning between the Northeast Area Office and DMH Central Office.

* Direct utilization management and review activities to evaluate the appropriateness, effectiveness, and quality of services provided to individuals receiving DMH-supported care.

* Support setting metrics/targets for quality improvement at both the Northeast Area, at the Site Offices, and in partnership with providers.

* Develop, review, and recommend Area-wide policies, procedures, and operational practices that promote regulatory compliance, consistency, accountability, and continuous quality improvement. Advocate for needed policies or procedures as needed/warranted.

* Lead and coordinate emergency preparedness planning activities, working with Area leadership, Site staff, and community partners to strengthen organizational readiness and response capabilities.

* Supervise and support assigned quality management, risk management, utilization management, and administrative staff, providing direction, establishing priorities, and promoting professional development and accountability.

* Collaborate with Area leadership, clinical teams, program directors, contracted providers, and DMH Central Office representatives to address complex service delivery challenges, coordinate improvement efforts, and promote consistent quality standards.

* Prepare and present quality management findings, performance analyses, and recommendations to leadership, using data from multiple information systems to guide planning, support corrective actions, and improve organizational performance.

* As a member of the Northeast Area leadership team, actively participate in NEA REI activities, including chairing/co-chairing committees and coordinating event attendance.

* Support procurement and re-procurement of contracts for the NEA by participating in review committees as needed/warranted and appropriate.

 

***Preferred Qualifications:***

* Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and managing quality assurance and performance improvement programs within behavioral health, mental health, healthcare, or human services organizations.

* Strong understanding of quality management principles, regulatory compliance requirements, risk management practices, and performance monitoring methodologies applicable to healthcare and community-based service systems.

* Knowledge of the Massachusetts Department of Mental Health service delivery system, including community-based mental health programs, contracted provider networks, and services supporting individuals with complex behavioral health needs.

* Proven ability to lead and supervise multidisciplinary teams, establish operational priorities, manage competing demands, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented work environment.

* Skilled in analyzing complex data, interpreting performance indicators, identifying service delivery trends, and translating findings into practical recommendations for organizational improvement.

* Experience with critical incident reviews, complaint investigations, fact-finding procedures, corrective action planning, and processes designed to strengthen client safety and service quality.

* Familiarity with contract monitoring, provider performance evaluations, utilization management, and oversight of publicly funded healthcare or human services programs.

* Demonstrated capacity to develop and implement policies, procedures, and quality improvement initiatives while balancing regulatory requirements, operational considerations, and the needs of individuals receiving services.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to prepare reports, present findings, facilitate training, and build consensus among diverse stakeholders.

* Track record of successfully coordinating cross-functional initiatives, collaborating with senior leadership and external providers, and using multiple data systems to support strategic planning, emergency preparedness, and continuous quality improvement.

Proficiency with Tableau and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint and Teams.

**About the Department of Mental Health (DMH):**

The Department of Mental Health assures and provides access to services and supports to meet the mental health needs of individuals of all ages, enabling them to live, work and participate in their communities. The Department establishes standards to ensure effective and culturally competent care to promote recovery. The Department sets policy, promotes self-determination, protects human rights and supports mental health training and research. Total Compensation: As an employee of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts you are offered a great career opportunity influencing a wide-spectrum of services to the diverse populations we serve — but it is more than a paycheck. The State ' s total compensation package features an outstanding set of employee benefits which you Should consider towards your overall compensation. including: - 75% state paid medical insurance premium - Reasonable Dental and Vision Plans - Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care Assistance programs - Low cost basic and optional life insurance - Retirernent Savings: State Employees ' Pension and a Deferred Compensation 457(b) plan 12 paid holidays per year and competitive Sick, Vacation and Personal Time - Tuition Benefit for employee and spouse at state colleges and universities - Long-Tem Disability and Extended Illness program participation options - Incentive-based Wellness Programs - Professional Development and Continuing Education opportunities - Qualified for Public Service Student Loan Forgiveness Pre.Hire Process: A criminal background check Will be completed on the recommended candidate as required by the regulations set forth by the Executive Office Of Health and Human Services prior to the candidate being hired. For more information, please Visit http://www.mass.gov/hhs/cori and click on •Information for Job Applicants. • Education, licensure and certifications will be verified in accordance with the Human Resources Division ' s Hiring Guidelines. Education and license/certification information provided by the selected candidate(s) is subject to the Massachusetts Public Records Law and may be published on the Commonwealth ' s website. If you would like to request an ADA or religious accommodation, please click on the link and complete the Reasonable Accommodation Online Request Form. For questions. please contact the Executive Office of Health and Human Services Office of Human Resources at 1-800-510-4122 and select option #2. For questions regarding this requisition. please contact Carol Duggan at carol.duggan@mass.gov or can (978)851-7321 Ext 2395.

**Qualifications**
------------------

MINIMUM ENTRANCE REQUIREMENTS:

 

Applicants must have at least (A) five (5) years of full-time or, equivalent part-time, professional, administrative, supervisory, or managerial experience in business administration, business management, public administration, public management, clinical administration or clinical management of which (B) at least one (1) year must have been in a project management, supervisory or managerial capacity or (C) any equivalent combination of the required experience and substitutions below.

 

Substitutions:

 

I. A certificate in a relevant or related field may be substituted for one (1) year of the required (A) experience.

 

II. A Bachelor's degree in a related field may be substituted for two (2) years of the required (A) experience.

 

III. A Graduate degree in a related field may be substituted for three (3) years of the required (A) experience.

 

IV. A Doctorate degree in a related field may be substituted for four (4) years of the required (A) experience.

 

**Salary placement is determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s years of directly related experience and education, and alignment with our internal compensation structure as set forth by the Human Resources Division’s Hiring Guidelines. For all bargaining unit positions (non-management), compensation is subject to the salary provisions outlined in the applicable collective bargaining agreement and will apply to placement within the appropriate salary range.**

**Comprehensive Benefits**

When you embark on a career with the Commonwealth, you are offered an outstanding suite of employee benefits that add to the overall value of your compensation package. We take pride in providing a work experience that supports you, your loved ones, and your future.

Want the specifics? Explore our Employee Benefits and Rewards!

The Regulation applies to this position. Successful candidates will be required to acknowledge and attest to your vaccination status for both COVID-19 and Influenza.**

 

**An Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. Females, minorities, veterans, and persons with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.**

 

The Commonwealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Research suggests that qualified women, Black, Indigenous, and Persons of Color (BIPOC) may self-select out of opportunities if they don't meet 100% of the job requirements. We encourage individuals who believe they have the skills necessary to thrive to apply for this role.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company preparing to launch AtzumiTM (dihydroergotamine (DHE) nasal powder), a novel therapeutic product approved in the US for the acute treatment of migraine. AtzumiTM incorporates proprietary advanced powder and device technology (SMART – Simple MucoAdhesive Release Technology™) and is designed to be easy-to-use, easy-to-carry and for quick self-administration.

**Position Summary:**

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is seeking an experienced, strategic leader to serve as Head of Quality Assurance. This individual will lead quality strategy and quality management systems through launch and early commercialization in the US. This role will oversee GxP quality activities across manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, quality systems, and vendor management to ensure inspection readiness and ongoing compliance. Furthermore, the Head of Quality Assurance will provide quality leadership for commercial launch readiness, including batch disposition, product release processes, complaint handling, deviations, CAPAs, change control, and product quality reviews. This is a critical leadership role responsible for scaling the quality organization to support the commercialization of Atzumiä (Dihydroergotamine) nasal powder and ensuring the highest standards of safety and efficacy. The successful candidate develops and provides quality strategy, vision, and direction across the organization, implementing company-wide GxP policies and practices and providing input to executive management, with decisions carrying long-term impact on the company's compliance posture and market success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain a scalable quality management system (QMS) that evolves from clinical-stage to commercial-readiness, ensuring compliance with FDA, ICH, and global GxP standards.
* Anticipate factors that could influence the company's quality strategy and market position, providing strategic direction across functional areas to support long-term compliance and business success.
* Establish and oversee robust commercial quality processes, including final product release/disposition, supply chain security, and distribution quality.
* Provide quality oversight for GLP, GCP, and GMP vendors; lead vendor qualifications, perform audits, and manage quality agreements with contract manufacturing and research organizations.
* Lead the management of deviations, CAPAs, change controls, and quality investigations, ensuring timely resolution and implementation of effective corrective actions.
* Proactively identify compliance risks and advise executive management on regulatory developments that impact company strategy.
* Apply persuasive, data-driven communication to influence executive decision-making on quality and regulatory strategy.
* Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of GxP SOPs, policies, and controlled documents across all functional areas.
* Establish and manage the company-wide GxP training program for employees and consultants to foster a corporate culture of quality and compliance.
* Oversee commercial quality systems, including product complaint handling, adverse event reporting coordination, and annual product quality reviews (APQR).
* Partner with executive leadership to cascade company-wide quality policies and practices, ensuring consistent adoption and alignment with organizational goals.
* Lead and develop the quality organization through subordinate managers and team members, overseeing the successful execution of company-wide quality initiatives.
* Proactively identify, assume, and execute additional responsibilities, initiatives, and special projects as business needs evolve.

**Minimum Requirements Education/Experience:**

* A Bachelor of Science degree in a life science discipline (biology, chemistry, etc.) is required; an advanced degree is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and articulate company-wide quality strategy, vision, and direction, with the ability to anticipate emerging risks and their impact on business success.
* 10+ years of industry experience in Quality Assurance within the pharmaceutical or biotech sectors, with at least 8 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading a quality function through a US commercial product launch and transitioning from clinical to commercial GxP requirements.
* Expert knowledge of US FDA GxP and ICH requirements; experience with European (EMA) or APAC regulations is highly desirable.
* Proven experience developing and implementing company-wide QMS platforms and managing complex quality investigations.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a "partnership approach" to working with cross-functional project teams and external partners.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (domestic and international) for vendor audits and site visits as required.
* Proven experience negotiating and influencing at the executive level, partnering with leadership to align quality strategy with organizational goals.

**Benefits and Pay:**

The expected salary range for this position is $230,000.00 - $270,000.00 USD. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is committed to providing its employees with benefit options that are comprehensive, competitive, and that individual employees can tailor to their and their families’ specific needs. Eligible employees are offered Health Insurance, Dental & Vision Insurance, Healthcare & Dependent Care FSA, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 401(k) Savings Plan, Long-term Incentive Plan, Life Insurance, Accident & Disability Insurance, Telemedicine, Generous Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays.

**EEO & Employment Eligibility:**

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We provide equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Satsuma Pharmaceuticals also complies with all applicable national, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification required of applicable law.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Technical Product Management — AI Quality & Evaluation
new_roles.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Product

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters** 
 
Help build the next generation of Agentforce. We’re an entrepreneurial incubation team within Salesforce, combining the pace and ownership of a startup with access to enterprise customers and Salesforce’s distribution. We’re looking for a technical product leader with deep AI expertise who wants to turn frontier capabilities into products customers can rely on.
 
 
Our team works closely with AI researchers, applied scientists, and engineers, uses coding agents extensively, and builds and experiments outside the core platform to iterate quickly. You’ll shape product strategy for AI quality and evaluation, establish how we measure progress, and personally lead a customer quality workstream and a focused feature from early learning through delivery.
 
 
This is a hands-on individual contributor leadership role, with an IC focus expected through 2027. You’ll lead through product ownership, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence while coaching colleagues, including junior designers and technical program managers. People-management responsibilities may develop as the product and team grow. You should enjoy inspecting traces and data, challenging evaluation results, prototyping with coding agents, and working directly with customers. Engineering partners own technical architecture and production implementation.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Set a coherent product strategy and roadmap for AI quality and evaluation, connecting customer needs, technical opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish shared quality definitions, evaluation requirements, coverage priorities, and release criteria with research, engineering, and product partners.
* Make explicit investment tradeoffs across customer quality improvements, evaluation capabilities, and product features; align teams on priorities and decision ownership.
* Personally lead customer investigations and experiments. For example, investigate why an agent gives an incorrect answer or fails a tool-driven workflow, define the expected behavior, and partner with researchers and engineers to test a change and validate its customer impact.
* Build an operating approach that connects customer feedback, evaluation evidence, experiments, releases, and learning across teams.
* Partner with researchers, applied scientists, and engineers to design credible evaluations. Apply AI/ML fundamentals such as training/test separation, overfitting, representative coverage, and independent validation to assess non-deterministic model behavior and grader reliability.
* Lead delivery of capabilities that help customers understand and improve AI performance. For example, prototype an experience that turns a failed agent interaction into an evaluation case, makes the quality gap clear, and helps a customer verify whether a proposed change works.
* Coach product partners, junior designers, and technical program managers in problem framing, experimentation, and delivery; raise the quality of decisions through mentorship and practical example.
Bring verified competitive insight into strategy and communicate differentiation, limitations, and investment choices clearly to customers and senior stakeholders. 

**Minimum Requirements**

* A record of building AI/ML products and delivering measurable customer outcomes, with increasing ownership, scope, and impact.
* Deep hands-on experience building AI agents and evaluation capabilities in close partnership with AI researchers, applied scientists, or AI engineers. One to two years of substantive generative AI experience can be sufficient when supported by strong AI/ML fundamentals and demonstrated impact.
* Strong applied AI/ML judgment across model behavior, prompting, retrieval, agent/tool workflows, and the tradeoffs among model, data, system, and product improvements.
* Current hands-on ability to inspect data and traces, prototype with coding agents, and reason about experiments, overfitting, training/test splits, edge cases, and uncertainty. You can define what good looks like for a non-deterministic system and challenge conclusions with technical partners.
* Principled, flexible thinking: frame the underlying customer problem, test assumptions, and change direction when evidence warrants it. You can explain when lessons from a previous product apply and when the context demands a different approach.
* Experience establishing shared standards and resolving cross-team disagreements while preserving clear accountability and delivery momentum.
* Evidence of coaching and mentoring colleagues without relying on reporting authority, and the ability to deliver independently in a fast-moving environment.
Clear communication with customers, technical teams, and senior leaders, including an honest account of what is known, uncertain, or still unproven. 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Evaluation platforms, agent systems, AI observability, retrieval, or enterprise AI products.
* Building in an AI-native startup or entrepreneurial environment, taking a new product from early customer learning to adoption, and applying lessons from both successful and unsuccessful experiments.
* Hands-on prototyping with coding agents and delivery of customer-facing performance or outcome experiences.
Leading initiatives that require agreement across research, engineering, product, and customer-facing organizations. 

What success looks like
 
 
Customers see credible improvement in real agent workflows, supported by evaluations they can trust. You independently take an initial quality problem from failure analysis through experimentation and customer validation, and deliver a focused feature with engineering. Teams make better release and investment decisions because of the evidence, product judgment, and coaching you bring.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.

The typical base salary range for this position is $218,400 - $365,200 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $263,200 - $401,400 annually.

The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

* Build an operating approach that connects customer feedback, evaluation evidence, experiments, releases, and learning across teams.
* Partner with researchers, applied scientists, and engineers to design credible evaluations. Apply AI/ML fundamentals such as training/test separation, overfitting, representative cover

* Strong applied AI/ML judgment across model behavior, prompting, retrieval, agent/tool workflows, and the tradeoffs among model, data, system, and product improvements.
* Current hands-on ability to inspect data and traces, prototype with coding agents, and reason about experiments, overfitting, training/test splits, edge cases, and uncertainty. You can define what good looks like for a non-deterministic system and challenge conclusions with technical partners.
* Principled, flexible thinking: frame the underlying customer problem, test assumptions, and change direction when evidence warrants

**Job Title: Director, Office of Quality, Risk, Incidents, & Investigations- Atlanta**

As the Director of the Office of Quality, Risk, and Incidents, plans, organize, direct, coordinate, evaluate and monitor healthcare programs and service delivery according to TJC and CMS standards and guidelines. Oversee, develop and implement related improvement projects and activities as well as policies and procedures.

 
 

* Collaborates and partners with other DBHDD Leaders and Departments to ensure State Hospitals’ goals and objectives are met

* Monitor State Hospital performance and develop policies and plans based on data collection, activity reports, planning documents, program plans and objectives
* Plan and organize program structure and policies to meet organizational and programmatic objectives according to TJC and CMS standards and guidelines
* Plan, organize, and direct hospital Quality, Risk, and Incident Management to ensure safety of individuals and staff
* Set priorities and implement goals and objectives to meet or resolve identified practice deficiencies and service delivery problems for the State Hospitals to meet accreditation standards and certifications
* Provides leadership to subordinate managers and staff
* In partnership with the State Hospitals Leadership Team, guide, direct and organize quality improvement projects and activities
* Interviews, hires, directs, trains, evaluates the performance of, and when necessary, disciplines and discharges employees
* Manages human resources and directs administrative activities to maintain an efficient and effective department
* Oversee, develop, and direct all Hospital Systems Committee improvement projects and activities
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of services and programs at State Hospitals through Mock Tracers and Audits 

**For benefits information, please visit:** **https://careers.dbhdd.ga.gov/why-dbhdd/**

To ensure the safety and wellbeing of our employees, individuals and communities we serve, certain positions within DBHDD may require evaluations, vaccinations, professional licensure and certifications. Licenses must be current and enable providers to practice within the State of Georgia.

 

The following are a listing of evaluations and vaccinations that may be required for employees, including those not involved with direct care:

 

* Drug Screening
* TB Evaluation
* Annual Influenza\*
 

* Limited exemptions may be made for documented medical contraindications or religious beliefs that object to vaccinations.

 

Due to the volume of applications received, we are unable to provide information on application status by phone or e-mail. All qualified applicants will be considered but may not necessarily receive an interview. Selected applicants will be contacted by the hiring agency for next steps in the selection process.

 

**This position is subject to close at any time once a satisfactory applicant pool has been identified.**

 

**FOR THIS TYPE OF EMPLOYMENT, STATE LAW REQUIRES A NATIONAL AND STATE BACKGROUND CHECK AS A CONDITION OF EMPLOYMENT.**

Bachelor's degree in health care services or related field from an accredited college or university and six (6) years of professional managerial or supervisory experience in health care services; or two (2) years of experience at the lower level Sr Mgr, Health Care (HCM013) or position equivalent.-Note: Some positions may require certification and/or licensure.

The State of Georgia does not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, or other protected categories in employment or the provision of services.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

 

**Pratt & Whitne**y is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Quality Director, Columbus Engine Center

**What You Will Do:**

* As the Quality Director for the Columbus Engine Center, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring a "quality-first" culture within a large, dynamic organization. You will lead strategic initiatives to enhance product safety, compliance, and operational excellence, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities will include:
* Providing strategic leadership for all Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and inspection activities across the Columbus Engine Center.
* Collaborating with Operations, Engineering, and Materials teams to ensure robust processes, effective change management, and prevention-based quality measures.
* Championing product safety through operational discipline and continuous improvement on the shop floor.
* Overseeing critical compliance programs, including training, records management, audits (internal, regulator, and customer), procedures, and major investigations.
* Monitoring and reporting on key quality metrics, developing action plans to achieve organizational goals.
* Ensuring adherence to AS9100, FAA, DCMA, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Leading root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives using CORE tools.
* Driving process capability improvements, defect reduction, and first-pass yield enhancements through data-driven decision-making.
* Managing nonconforming material, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and risk assessments for critical aerospace components.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Bachelor’s degree and 14 years of experience, or 12 years of experience with an Advanced degree.
* Experience in Quality Management within the Aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing industry.
* Senior leadership or people management experience.
* Experience in Operations, Quality, or Engineering within the Aerospace manufacturing industry.

**Qualifications We Prefer**:

* 5+ years of experience in Operations Leadership.
* Experience leading organizations and other leaders.
* Aftermarket Aerospace / Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) experience.
* Familiarity with FAR-145 / CFR-145 Repair Station operations.
* Knowledge of FAA regulatory compliance.
* Background in Engineering.
* Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) Certification.
* Experience with SAP Quality systems.
* Understanding of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).

Learn More & Apply Now!

Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

This position is considered safety sensitive in accordance with FAA Guidelines. Candidate will be subject to drug and alcohol testing per FAA's regulation 14 CFR part 120, as well as 49 CFR part 40.

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 186,200 USD - 353,800 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences. 
The Director, Quality Engineering – Test Data Management (EQE) is a senior technology leader responsible for defining, advancing, and operating Humana's enterprise Test Data Management (TDM) function within Enterprise Quality Engineering. Reporting to the VP, Quality Engineering, this role leads the strategy, operating model, and execution of secure, scalable, compliant, and automation-enabled test data capabilities that support software delivery across Humana's business and technology organizations. 
This leader is accountable for building and leading a high-performing organization responsible for core TDM services, including test data provisioning, synthetic data generation, masking, de-identification, data lifecycle management, and environment data coordination. The Director will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Risk, and Data teams to ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to delivery, compliance, and release readiness needs. 
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in test data management, data engineering, governance, privacy, and automation in a complex enterprise environment. This role will drive modernization of TDM practices through automation-first and AI-enabled capabilities, while establishing standards, controls, and reusable services that improve engineering throughput, reduce delivery friction, and strengthen compliance and data protection across non-production environments.

**Responsibilities**

**Leadership, Strategy & Operating Model**

* Lead the enterprise Test Data Management function within EQE, including strategic direction, operating model execution, and organizational development.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of managers, engineers, and test data specialists across multiple groups supporting segment and enterprise needs.
* Oversee a distributed organization of **50+ associates** and create clear priorities, role clarity, and performance expectations.
* Partner with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data teams to align TDM services with business and delivery priorities.
* Drive a scalable support model for segment TDM services across multiple portfolios and delivery teams.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of secure test data practices.

**Test Data Engineering & Management**

 

* Lead enterprise engineering and management of secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Oversee delivery of core TDM capabilities, including:Test data provisioningSynthetic data generationData masking and obfuscationData de-identificationData quality enablementTest data automationData lifecycle managementEnvironment data coordination
* Ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to quality engineering, release, and environment needs.
* Advance data engineering practices that improve the reliability, reusability, and speed of test data provisioning across delivery pipelines.
* Support complex testing needs across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and non-production validation use cases.

**AI-Enabled & Automation-First TDM**

 

* Drive **AI-enabled** and automation-first TDM strategies to improve speed, intelligence, scalability, and coverage of test data operations.
* Expand the use of AI and advanced automation for synthetic data generation, sensitive data detection, masking rule optimization, provisioning efficiency, and data quality insights.
* Integrate TDM automation into CI/CD and engineering workflows where applicable to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
* Partner with enterprise engineering and platform teams to modernize TDM tooling, workflows, and reusable patterns.
* Establish metrics to evaluate automation effectiveness, data readiness, cycle time reduction, and business value realization.

**Governance, Standards, Compliance & Privacy**

 

* Define and enforce enterprise TDM standards, governance, and operating policies.
* Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements related to test data usage, storage, movement, masking, and de-identification.
* Oversee implementation of compliance and privacy controls for non-production data usage.
* Establish standards for secure handling of production-like data in test environments.
* Partner with security, risk, privacy, and compliance stakeholders to maintain appropriate controls and audit readiness.
* Promote consistent governance for test data access, retention, refresh, lineage, and lifecycle management.

**Delivery Enablement & Stakeholder Partnership**

 

* Enable delivery teams through timely, compliant, and high-quality test data services that improve engineering throughput and release readiness.
* Partner with segment quality engineering leaders and application teams to understand demand patterns and align TDM support to delivery roadmaps.
* Coordinate across environments and shared services to reduce delays related to data setup, refresh, and availability.
* Influence engineering and quality practices that improve testability, environment readiness, and quality outcomes.
* Collaborate with enterprise enablement and platform teams to standardize capabilities and reduce duplication.

**Metrics, Governance & Continuous Improvement**

 

* Define and monitor KPIs related to test data availability, provisioning speed, automation adoption, compliance adherence, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Use data and insights to identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across TDM services.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce manual work, increase data reliability, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Provide clear reporting and operational transparency to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build maturity roadmaps for enterprise TDM capabilities and measure progress against defined outcomes.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any technology related degree or equivalent experience.
* **10+ years** of experience in quality engineering, test data management, data engineering, software engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* **5+ years** of leadership experience managing enterprise-scale technology teams, including managers and geographically distributed associates.
* Experience leading or scaling **test data management**, data engineering, or quality engineering functions in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated success building and operating secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Experience with key TDM capabilities such as data provisioning, masking, obfuscation, de-identification, synthetic data generation, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of privacy, security, and compliance considerations for test data in regulated environments.
* Experience driving automation and process modernization across engineering or quality workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, quality, data, and business organizations.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments and supporting modern software delivery practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Experience in healthcare, payer/insurance, or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience supporting enterprise quality engineering or platform enablement organizations.
* Familiarity with test data management platforms, masking tools, synthetic data solutions, and data quality tooling.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise engineering platforms.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
The Director of Quality Engineering – Automation & Performance is the senior technical, delivery, and practice leader for iLAB U.S. Automation and Performance Testing. The role is accountable for the day-to-day management of U.S. engineering initiatives and resources, while also providing hands-on consulting leadership for strategic clients.

This leader defines the practice strategy, architecture, standards, delivery assurance, reusable solutions, and capability roadmap for Automation and Performance Testing. Working as part of a global delivery organization, they combine technical credibility, client leadership, people management, and commercial judgment to deliver measurable quality outcomes, strengthen service offerings, and build scalable engineering capability.

* Own the day-to-day delivery, prioritization, staffing, allocation, utilization, performance, and technical direction of all iLAB U.S. Automation and Performance Testing initiatives and resources.
* Define and evolve Automation and Performance Testing strategies, capability roadmaps, service offerings, architectures, standards, frameworks, methods, tools, reusable accelerators, and intellectual property.
* Oversee technical assurance across high-impact deliveries, including solution architecture, automation and performance engineering design, CI/CD integration, AI-enabled engineering guardrails, test-data readiness, and environment readiness.
* Lead critical client-facing activities, including technical discovery, project kickoffs, solutioning workshops, executive presentations, steering reviews, escalations, and project recovery.
* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex or at-risk engagements and personally provide architecture, assessment, technical review, troubleshooting, and recovery leadership until delivery is stabilized.
* Lead the technical development and review of RFIs, RFPs, proposals, SOWs, estimates, staffing models, assumptions, deliverables, risks, acceptance criteria, and service commitments
* Establish and oversee practical engineering governance, including quality gates, code and architecture reviews, documentation standards, source-control practices, repository security, and technical approval processes.
* Define and guide responsible, value-focused uses of AI within Automation and Performance Testing, including test design assistance, script development and maintenance, results analysis, defect insight, and knowledge retrieval, while applying company security, privacy, data-handling, and human-review requirements
* Hire, coach, develop, and retain engineering managers, architects, principal engineers, and technical specialists; establish competency expectations, career paths, succession plans, and backup coverage for critical capabilities.
* Collaborate with global delivery leaders to align technical standards, share reusable assets and expertise, and support other geographies with strategic client and delivery needs.
* Partner with Sales, Professional Services, Operations, Finance, and Talent Management on capacity planning, forecasting, utilization, delivery margin and growth opportunities.
* Represent iLAB as a Quality Engineering thought leader through conferences, industry events, client advisory councils, publications, demonstrations, and market-facing content.

* At least 15 years of progressive experience in Quality Engineering, including senior leadership of complex Automation and Performance Testing solutions, consulting engagements, engineering teams, and CxO-level client relationships
* Deep knowledge of Automation and Performance Testing strategies, architectures, frameworks, tools, workload models, execution practices, analysis, reporting, and integration with modern software delivery pipelines
* Experience leading technical delivery across multiple clients, programs, or business units, including distributed teams and critical project recovery.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD integration, testability, observability, test-data and environment readiness, cloud delivery, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
* Proven people leadership, including resource planning, coaching, performance management, prioritization, utilization, and organizational development.
* Strong consulting and client-advisory skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions and delivery plans.
* Experience shaping proposals, SOWs, estimates, resource models, and commercial commitments.
* Sound understanding of consulting engagement economics, including forecasting, utilization, margin, cost-to-serve, and measurable client outcomes.
* A mature, politically astute leadership style; calm in a crisis, able to lead by influence and example, with excellent written and oral communication.
* Willing and able to travel interstate and occasionally internationally for critical client-facing initiatives, project kickoffs, workshops, presentations, escalations, and recovery efforts.
* Demonstrated experience in a Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Automation, or Performance Testing consulting or professional-services organization.
* Experience across the consulting lifecycle and multi-country delivery teams; relevant industry expertise and advanced professional certifications are beneficial.
