new_roles.title: Director of Quality – Women’s and Children Services
new_roles.description:
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Quality, Safety, Accreditation and Policy provides strategic and operational leadership for clinical 
quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, accreditation compliance, and organizational policy management 
across a large, complex medical center. The Director establishes priorities, ensures alignment across clinical and 
operational functions, and partners with physician, nursing, operational, and administrative executives to 
advance high reliability, continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and patient-centered care. This position 
has accountability for the design, execution, and sustained performance of quality improvement, patient safety, 
accreditation, policy governance, performance measurement, and regulatory compliance programs. The Director 
translates organizational strategy into medical center-wide priorities, evaluates performance and risk, directs 
corrective action, and provides executive leaders with recommendations needed to achieve organizational goals 
and external standards. 
What You Will Do 

* Quality and Performance Improvement
* Establish and lead the organization's quality, safety, accreditation, and policy strategy in alignment with

organizational strategy and medical center priorities. 

* Set the performance improvement agenda and direct organization-wide and departmental initiatives,

including prioritization, resource allocation, accountability, and sustainability of results. 

* Establish performance expectations and governance for key quality indicators, publicly reported

measures, regulatory metrics, and improvement commitments; intervene when performance or 
compliance is at risk. 

* Facilitate data-driven improvement efforts using Lean, Six Sigma, PDSA, and other improvement

methodologies. 

* Own the integrity, interpretation, and executive communication of quality dashboards, scorecards, and

performance reporting, including recommendations for action and escalation. 

* Partner with physician and nursing leaders to improve clinical outcomes, reliability, equity, and patient

experience. 

* Exercise decision-making authority within the assigned portfolio and escalate material quality, safety,

regulatory, or accreditation risks to executive leadership and appropriate governance bodies. 

* Define accountability structures for leaders responsible for performance improvement plans and verify

that corrective actions produce sustained results. 

* Patient Safety
* Provide leadership for the patient safety program and establish expectations for a culture of safety, high

reliability, transparency, learning, and accountability 

* Direct governance for event reporting, root cause analyses, apparent cause analyses, and corrective

action plans; ensure timely escalation, leadership accountability, and validation that risk-reduction 
actions are effective and sustained. 

* In partnership with Risk and clinical loss control, monitor serious safety events, near misses, and highreliability

metrics. 

* Collaborate with risk management, infection prevention, and operational leaders on safety priorities.
* Integrate patient safety, infection prevention, clinical risk, quality improvement, and regulatory priorities

to reduce duplication, close gaps, and promote consistent practices across care settings. 

* Support implementation of evidence-based practices to reduce preventable harm.
* Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance
* Provide oversight of Joint Commission, DNV, CMS, state, and specialty accreditation readiness,

partnering with the designated accreditation leader who directs day-to-day readiness activities to include 
establishing priorities, assigning corrective actions, and escalating unresolved compliance risks. 

* Oversee organizational responses to survey findings and regulatory deficiencies, including corrective

action governance, evidence submission, validation of sustained compliance, and executive escalation; 
monitor regulatory changes and communicate implications to leadership; and partner with operational 
leaders to address gaps and sustain compliance. 

* Policy Management and Governance
* Lead policy governance and document control processes including standards for development, approval,

publication, review, exception management, and retirement. 

* Ensure policies remain current, evidence-based, and aligned with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate policy review cycles and approvals with clinical, operational, legal, compliance, and executive

stakeholders.

Evaluate policy compliance trends and identify improvement opportunities. 

* Resolve or escalate cross-functional policy conflicts and ensure accountable leaders address material

gaps in policy implementation or adherence. 

* Maintain oversight of organizational policy standards and publication processes. Consistent with UH

policy governance structures, accreditation, compliance, legal, quality, and operational leaders 
collaborate to ensure policy adherence and regulatory alignment. 

* Academic Mission Support
* Collaborate with medical school leadership, residency and fellowship programs, and research leadership

to integrate quality, safety, and regulatory expectations into organizational programs. 

* Support quality and safety education for medical students, residents, fellows, and faculty.
* Leadership and Operations
* Establish departmental goals, operating plans, budgets, staffing models, and resource priorities; monitor

financial and operational performance and adjust plans as organizational needs change. 

* Build leadership capability and succession plans for quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, policy, and

performance improvement professionals; hold direct reports accountable for measurable outcomes. 

* Serve as the quality and safety advisor to executive, physician, nursing, and operational leadership,

providing independent evaluation of performance, risk, regulatory exposure, and improvement priorities. 

* Present quality, safety, accreditation, regulatory, and policy performance to governing boards, executive

committees, and medical staff leadership; recommend decisions, investments, and corrective actions. 

* Chair or lead multidisciplinary governance committees focused on quality, accreditation, safety,

regulatory compliance, and policy, with authority to establish agendas, assign accountability, and 
escalate unresolved issues. 

* Negotiate priorities and resource needs across competing operational demands while protecting

regulatory compliance, patient safety, and organizational performance. 

* Represent the medical center in organization-wide councils and, as assigned, with external regulators,

accrediting organizations, professional associations, and community partners.

**Additional Responsibilities** 

* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Complies with all policies and standards.
* For specific duties and responsibilities, refer to documentation provided by the department during

orientation. 

* Must abide by all requirements to safely and securely maintain Protected Health Information (PHI) for

our patients. Annual training, the UH Code of Conduct and UH policies and procedures are in place to 
address appropriate use of PHI in the workplace.

**Education Qualifications** 

* Bachelor's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or

related field (Required) 

* Master's Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Business Administration, or related

field Preferred (Preferred)

**Experience Qualifications** 

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, accreditation, regulatory, and clinical

leadership experience with several years in people management capacity[ (Required) 

* Experience within an academic medical center, integrated delivery system, or large healthcare

organization. (Required) 
• • Experience with Joint Commission/DNV survey leadership. • Experience overseeing policy governance. 

* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior and executive leaders, managing

organizational change, and sustaining measurable results across complex operations. • Experience 
presenting to governing boards, executive committees, medical staff leadership, or comparable senior 
governance groups. • Experience managing budgets, staffing plans, and resource allocation for a 
complex function or department. (Preferred

**Licenses and Certifications** 
• • Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) • Certified Professional in Patient Safety (CPPS) • 
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent • Healthcare accreditation or regulatory certification 
(Preferred)

**Physical Demands**

* Standing Occasionally
* Walking Occasionally
* Sitting Constantly
* Lifting Rarely 20 lbs
* Carrying Rarely 20 lbs
* Pushing Rarely 20 lbs
* Pulling Rarely 20 lbs
* Climbing Rarely 20 lbs
* Balancing Rarely
* Stooping Rarely
* Kneeling Rarely
* Crouching Rarely
* Crawling Rarely
* Reaching Rarely
* Handling Occasionally
* Grasping Occasionally
* Feeling Rarely
* Talking Constantly
* Hearing Constantly
* Repetitive Motions Frequently
* Eye/Hand/Foot Coordination Frequently

**Travel Requirements**

* 10%

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
As a Plant Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for overseeing the operations and performance of our manufacturing plant. You will develop and implement strategies to optimize plant operations, improve productivity, and reduce costs. Ensuring compliance with safety regulations and promoting a culture of safety throughout the plant will be a key responsibility.

You will report directly to our VP ISC Americas & Pacific and you’ll work out of our Tempe, Arizona location on an On-site work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the success of our business by leading and managing a team to meet production targets and deliver on customer commitments. You will play a critical role in ensuring the efficient production of high-quality products while maintaining a safe and productive work environment. Your leadership and strategic decision-making skills will be essential in driving operational excellence and achieving business objectives.

 

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Minimum of 6 years of experience in plant management or a similar leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes and best practices.
* Proven track record of driving operational excellence and achieving business objectives.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in managing plant budgets and resources effectively to meet financial goals.
* Ability to lead continuous improvement initiatives and implement best practices in a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in Electronic assembly process experience.

**WE VALUE**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* Experience with Lean Six Sigma certification and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets effectively.
* Experience in developing and leading diverse teams to achieve operational goals.
Excellent problem-solving skills and strategic decision-making abilities. 

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

**ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES**

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. Learn more

**THE BUSINESS UNIT**

Honeywell Building Automation (BA) is a leading global provider of products, software, solutions, and technologies that enable building owners and occupants to ensure their facilities are safe, energy efficient, sustainable, and productive. BA products and services include advanced software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems, and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance, and upgrades of systems. Revenues in 2022 for BA were $6B and there are approximately 18,000 employees globally. To learn more, please visit https://buildings.honeywell.com/

**BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL**

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Learn more

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting Date: 11/10/2026.

*Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status.* Learn more

 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead and manage the plant operations to meet production targets and deliver on customer commitments.
* Develop and implement strategies to optimize plant operations, improve productivity, and reduce costs.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and promote a culture of safety throughout the plant.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives and implement best practices.
* Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions to address any deviations from targets.
* Manage the plant budget and resources effectively to achieve financial goals.

new_roles.title: VP of Operations
new_roles.description:
Description:

### **JOB SUMMARY:**

The General Manager reports directly to the President and leads the Watertown, Connecticut location. This role translates company strategy into daily execution and is accountable for site performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction.

As a member of the Leadership Team, the General Manager establishes operational controls, reporting systems, and performance expectations to improve profitability, workforce development, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term business sustainability. The role collaborates with Sales, Finance, Engineering, Human Resources, Quality, and Operations across locations.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

#### **Operational Leadership & Strategy:**

* Lead daily site operations and align departmental priorities, resources, and execution with company strategy.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and monitor performance indicators for safety, quality, on-time delivery, labor efficiency, inventory accuracy, first-pass yield, productivity, and profitability.
* Use operational reports and dashboards to identify performance gaps, assign corrective actions, and monitor results.

#### **Process & Financial Performance:**

* Manage site operational budgeting, labor planning, cost controls, and financial performance in collaboration with Finance and within approved authority.
* Lead initiatives to reduce waste, improve workflow, standardize processes, and apply lean manufacturing principles.
* Coordinate production priorities and resource planning across departments and locations to support customer commitments.
* Evaluate and implement approved technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve efficiency and reduce non-value-added work.

#### **Safety, Quality & Customer Collaboration:**

* Manage and continuously improve the site safety program in coordination with designated company resources; ensure adherence to applicable company policies and safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure site adherence to applicable quality management systems and ISO requirements; support audits, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Quality, and customer-facing teams to address customer needs, delivery commitments, product quality, and issue resolution.

#### **Leadership & Talent Development:**

* Lead and mentor department managers and operational leaders to improve accountability, consistency, and professional development.
* Develop succession plans and leadership development initiatives to strengthen organizational depth and business continuity.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee

Requirements:

### **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide site-level leadership and oversight of department managers and operational leaders within the assigned reporting structure.
* Establish performance expectations, provide regular feedback, and assess development needs in coordination with Human Resources and company leadership.

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

#### **Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong business acumen and understanding of manufacturing operations, finance, quality systems, supply chain, customer service, sales support, and workforce management.
* Ability to lead operational change, build trust, and develop accountability and employee engagement across organizational levels.
* Proficiency in manufacturing metrics, operational reporting, financial analysis, and cost controls.
* Experience implementing process improvements, lean manufacturing initiatives, and operational standardization.
* Ability to use ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and other business systems to improve operational effectiveness.

#### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred, but not required.
* At least eight years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, printing, converting, industrial production, or a related operational environment.
* Demonstrated success leading teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with responsibility for operational performance and measurable business results.
* Experience with custom manufacturing, technical products, labels, graphic overlays, membrane switches, or related industries preferred.
* Experience managing within ISO-certified or regulated manufacturing environments preferred.

### **LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information internally and externally across organizational levels.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills strongly preferred to support employee engagement, training, and operational communication.

### **MATHEMATICAL & ANALYTICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to interpret budgets, labor and production data, costs, inventory reports, and operational performance trends.
* Ability to use data to evaluate priorities, identify causes of performance gaps, and assess improvement results.

### **REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to think and act strategically and tactically, manage competing priorities, and make sound operational decisions.
* Ability to analyze problems, evaluate alternatives, and coordinate practical solutions across departments.

### **WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Work is performed in office and manufacturing settings, with exposure to moving production equipment when entering production areas.
* Follow applicable site safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment in designated areas.
* Travel to customers, vendors, and JN White corporate as needed.

**Position Type and Compensation** 
This is a full-time, salaried, exempt position based in Watertown, Connecticut. The annual base salary range is $120,000–$150,000. Compensation within this range will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and internal equity.

**Benefits** 
JN White offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, with premium costs shared between the employee and employer. A variety of ancillary insurance benefits are also available; employee contributions and employer contributions, where applicable, vary by coverage elected.

Additional benefits include paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, a 401(k) retirement plan, and profit sharing. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, waiting periods, company policies, and governing plan documents. Profit sharing is subject to plan terms and is not guaranteed.

**Equal Employment Opportunity** 
JN White is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, age, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Reasonable Accommodations** 
JN White provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees as required by applicable law. Applicants who need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process may contact Human Resources.

**Employment Disclaimer** 
This posting describes the general nature of the position and does not constitute an offer of employment or an employment contract. Employment with JN White is at will, subject to applicable law. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

**Company Overview**

Third Space Brewing is a 10 year old production brewery operation producing 10,000+ barrels of beer annually in addition to other crafted beverages.

**Position Summary**

Department Director position responsible for coordinating management of all Brewery activities across recipe development, production management, quality and maintenance to meet production demands and help further a culture of quality, safety and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

- 21+ years old

- Bachelor’s degree in food science, engineering, biology or other related science

- 5+ years of experience in a production brewery or related food manufacturing facility

- 3+ years management experience directly managing production/manufacturing personnel

- Formal Brewing education from recognized institution preferred

**Key Competencies**

- Ability to manage, motivate and develop staff

- Familiarity with technology typical to a medium-sized brewery operation including equipment, software, etc

- Knowledge of safety hazards present in brewing environment and interest in creating a culture of safety

- Strong organizational and record keeping skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Ability to troubleshoot and problem-solve complex issues

- Passion for beer, brewing and production

- Knowledge of brewing science, raw material selection and handling

- Experience creating and refining beer recipes on a production scale

- Commitment to on-going learning and improvement

**Essential Job Functions**

- Oversight and management of the Brewery team including hiring, scheduling, training, evaluating, etc

- Help shape overall Brewery strategic planning with emphasis on company long-term goals and employee ownership of process

- Work with Brewmaster on all new product development

- Ensure quality standards are established and met

- Ensure all brewery equipment is properly used and maintained

- Establish a focus on safety and a safe brewery culture

- Lead improvement initiatives that help drive department and company goals

- Work with finance department to create annual budget for department

- Actively seek ways to contribute, improve and strengthen employee and company culture

**Benefits**

- Access to company Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance with employer contribution

- Access to company 401(k) plan with employer match

- Generous PTO package

- Paid Holidays

- Paid Maternity/Paternity Leave

- Beer Allocation

- Employee Discounts

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many years of brewery experience do you have?

new_roles.title: Director of Continuous Improvement & Business System Development
new_roles.description:
Skybound Service Partners is a national platform dedicated to partnering with leading commercial roofing and building services companies. We invest in exceptional teams, proven businesses, and long-term relationships to help our partner companies grow stronger and deliver greater value to their customers. At Skybound, we offer more than a job, we offer the opportunity to build a meaningful career within a network that prioritizes people, performance, and sustainable success.

Skybound Service Partners is a private equity-backed commercial roofing platform of five regional brands, and we're continuing to grow through acquisition. Each brand keeps its own name, leadership, and P&L. Skybound provides the shared support and systems that help them grow faster together. Our work happens on rooftops, on jobsites, and in trucks, not on a production line.

**The Role** 
We're looking for a builder to take the Skybound Business System (SBS) from concept to a working system across every brand. You'll partner with the executive team to define the framework, build the tools, and deploy them. You'll also lead continuous improvement projects from start to finish, focused on standard work, waste reduction, and productivity. The brands own their businesses, so this role leads through influence, not mandate.

**What You'll Do**

* Partner with the executive team to define SBS principles, tools, and operating cadence, starting from what already works inside the brands.
* Own multi-site CI roadmaps tied to business priorities, with the governance and KPIs to track adoption and results.
* Drive CI projects from start to implementation, including standard work for our core processes across all brands.
* Embed daily management, visual metrics, and structured problem solving at every site, adapted for field crews and project-based work.
* Lead kaizen events and training, and build a certification path so internal practitioners can run improvement work on their own.
* Bring SBS fundamentals into newly acquired brands as part of each integration, while respecting what those businesses already do well.
* Partner with IT on technology, including AI and automation, to reduce manual work and improve consistency.

**What It Takes**

* **Builder, not just an operator.** There's no playbook waiting for you. You've built a system where none existed, and a blank page energizes you.
* **Influences without authority.** You earn adoption by making leaders more successful, and you know what needs a common standard and what should stay local.
* **Credible with leadership and on the roof.** You're as effective with the executive team as you are with superintendents, foremen, and estimators.
* **Teacher first.** You measure success by how many leaders can run a kaizen without you.
* **Results over ceremony.** Every improvement ties to cycle time, quality, cash, or margin.
* **Owns outcomes.** When something stalls, you say so, find out why, and fix it or stop it.
* **Hands-on with technology.** You're comfortable building an AI or automation prototype yourself before handing it to IT.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 10–20 years of experience in operations and continuous improvement, including roles with direct responsibility for results
* A proven track record of leading large-scale process mapping and standard work rollouts
* Experience building a CI function or business system where none existed
* Bachelor's degree
* Must live near a major airport (Eastern or Central time zone preferred) and be willing to travel heavily during initial rollouts, settling to under 50%

*Preferred*

* CI leadership in field service, service operations, construction, or another service or project-based business
* Hands-on experience leading (not just participating in) a lean business system rollout, such as the Danaher Business System, Fortive Business System, or similar
* Experience rolling out a business system in newly acquired businesses
* Lean or Six Sigma certification; equivalent hands-on rollout experience is valued equally
* Advanced degree

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

* SBS principles, operating cadence, and core tools agreed with leadership and launched at pilot sites
* Standard work established for our core processes across all five brands
* Measurable gains in cycle time, quality, and margin, validated by finance
* AI and automation tools piloted to reduce manual work
* A first group of internal practitioners trained and running improvement work on their own
* A repeatable process for bringing newly acquired brands onto the system

*Thank you for considering a career with Skybound Service Partners.**We believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We invest in our people and provide competitive pay, benefits, and a supportive work environment where your skills and contributions matter.*

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations** 
**Micro-Tronics, Inc. | Tempe, AZ**

Full-Time | Exempt 
Shift: Monday-Friday, 6:00 am to 4:00 pm

**About Micro-Tronics**
=======================

Micro-Tronics, Inc. is a precision aerospace manufacturing company committed to operational excellence, quality, and continuous improvement. We are seeking a results-driven Director of Operations to lead our manufacturing operations and drive performance across production, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and workforce planning. This role is instrumental in delivering customer commitments, achieving revenue objectives, improving operational efficiency, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Operations oversees daily plant operations with primary accountability for reducing past-due orders, improving manufacturing efficiency, and achieving company revenue targets while maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety. This position provides strategic and operational leadership across manufacturing operations, labor planning, production scheduling, budgeting, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Director of Operations aligns production capacity, scheduling, and shipments with customer commitments and business objectives while driving corrective actions when performance falls short.

**Key Interactions and Relationships**
======================================

Internal: Senior Management, Assembly, Machining, Elastomer Manufacturing, Quality Control, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Human Resources.

External: Customers, Suppliers, Regulatory Agencies and Governing Bodies.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Supervise and manage plant personnel, including recruiting, training, coaching, and performance management.
* Plan, organize, direct, and manage daily operations to reduce past-due orders, improve manufacturing efficiency, and achieve revenue objectives.
* Develop and improve manufacturing processes to increase throughput and labor productivity while reducing cycle times, downtime, scrap, and rework.
* Oversee production scheduling, maintenance, and logistics to ensure customer delivery commitments are achieved.
* Monitor past-due orders, prioritize recovery efforts, and eliminate material and capacity constraints.
* Manage operational budgets and expenses.
* Ensure all products meet customer requirements, regulatory standards, and company quality objectives.
* Maintain a safe work environment through enforcement of company policies, procedures, and OSHA requirements.
* Manage operational budgets and expenses while aligning production and shipment performance with monthly and quarterly revenue goals.
* Establish and maintain effective controls over capital expenditures, operating expenses, staffing, and labor costs.
* Maintain and review operational scorecards and KPIs while coordinating corrective actions with Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Human Resources.
* Drive resolution of safety incidents, customer returns, nonconformances, production scrap, inventory concerns, and supplier performance issues.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
=====================================

* Operational efficiency and productivity
* Product quality and compliance
* On-time delivery and backlog reduction
* Revenue growth and budget management
* Safety and risk performance
* Scrap, nonconformance, and customer return reduction
* Inventory accuracy and customer satisfaction

**Qualifications**
==================

**Education, Licenses and Certifications**

A bachelor's degree in engineering, manufacturing, business administration, or a related field is required.

**Leadership Skills / Soft Skills**

* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to foster a positive and productive work environment.
* Mentorship and team-building skills.
* Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Individual Contributor Knowledge and Skills**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to analyze operational data and make informed decisions.
* Knowledge of industry regulations and compliance requirements.

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

This is an active position requiring the ability to:

* Stand and walk for extended periods.
* Sit for extended periods as business needs require.
* Operate forklifts, scissor lifts, and other material handling equipment.
* Lift and move up to **50 pounds**.
* Work throughout manufacturing environments, including elevated work areas and outdoor conditions when necessary.
* Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

**Our Values**
==============

* **Being Accountable** – Taking ownership of responsibilities, following through on commitments, acting with integrity, and producing quality results.
* **Being Collaborative** – Working respectfully and effectively with others, sharing knowledge, communicating openly, and contributing to team success.
* **Being Empowered** – Demonstrating initiative, solving problems proactively, embracing continuous improvement, and making informed decisions within the scope of the position

**Benefits**
============

At Micro-Tronics Inc., we recognize how important your career and benefits are to you and your family. We offer a full suite of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability coverage, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, basic and supplemental life insurance, employee assistance plan, retirement savings and matching, and other developmental opportunities. We are committed to supporting the way you live and work.

**Apply Today**
===============

If you are passionate about operational leadership, manufacturing excellence, continuous improvement, and driving business results, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Micro-Tronics team.

**Micro-Tronics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to complete the application process may contact Human Resources.**

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations**

**Arden's Garden | Atlanta, Georgia | Full-time, On-site**

**About Arden's Garden**

Since 1995, Arden's Garden has been on a mission to bring good health to all. Today, we operate 19 retail locations, manufacture our own products, and distribute through thousands of grocery stores, including Publix, Kroger, Whole Foods, and Sprouts.

We're a growing, entrepreneurial company looking for an exceptional leader to help take us to the next level.

**The Opportunity**

We're seeking a strategic, results-driven Director of Operations to lead our retail and manufacturing operations. You'll lead and develop our experienced operational leadership team, strengthen accountability, improve profitability, and build the systems that support our growth.

A major part of this role is leading our push to bring AI and modern tools into every part of the business. We're looking for someone who sees how technology can take us to the next level and makes it happen.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead our effort to bring AI, automation, and data into the business, in areas like demand forecasting, labor scheduling, inventory and ordering, production planning, and real-time reporting.
* Lead, coach and develop our retail and manufacturing leadership teams.
* Drive operational excellence, efficiency and profitability across the business.
* Establish clear goals, performance expectations and accountability.
* Identify challenges, develop solutions and ensure successful execution.
* Improve processes, systems and communication across departments.
* Manage operational budgets, performance metrics and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Partner closely with the COO and senior leadership to execute company strategy and support growth.

**In Your First Year, You'll**

* Identify our highest-value opportunities for AI and launch at least three tools, such as forecasting, scheduling, or automated reporting, that measurably save time, cut costs, or improve decisions.
* Help our teams adopt and use these tools day-to-day.
* Strengthen financial accountability and improve profitability across retail and manufacturing.
* Reduce waste and bring labor costs in line with targets.
* Develop your leaders and prepare them for bigger roles.

**Growth Opportunity**

This is a high-impact position with significant autonomy and the chance to make a meaningful difference in a growing company. The Director of Operations reports to the COO and works closely with our senior leadership team. For the right person, there is tremendous potential to advance into a senior executive leadership role.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive compensation, performance-based bonus and benefits.

**We're looking for someone who sees what needs to be done, figures out how to do it, and makes** **it happen, while inspiring others to do the same!**

**What We're Looking For**

* 6+ years of operations leadership, including 3+ years leading managers.
* Proven success leading complex operations and delivering measurable results.
* A track record of implementing technology and AI tools, assisting teams with adoption, and transforming how the business runs.
* A self-motivated, resourceful problem solver who thinks independently, takes ownership, and consistently follows through.
* Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on, solutions-oriented approach.
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, delegating effectively, and building accountable teams.
* Strong financial acumen and experience building and improving systems and processes.
* Outstanding communication skills and the ability to build relationships across the organization.
* Experience in multi-unit retail or manufacturing is highly valued; food and beverage experience is strongly preferred.
* A genuine connection to our mission of good health for all.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Frozen Food Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

Table 87 Frozen LLC is a national frozen pizza manufacturer and “The Home Of The Coal Oven Slice.” Born in Brooklyn NY, founder Thomas Cucco opened his first slice shop in Brooklyn Heights in 2012. Today, Table 87 runs three authentic coal-oven pizza shops while operating its own vertically integrated frozen production facility that ships its signature frozen pizza nationwide. After national exposure on ABC’s Shark Tank, Table 87 has scaled into top retailers and distributors across the USA, bringing authentic Brooklyn NY coal-oven pizza to freezers everywhere.

**Role Description**

The Director of Operations, Frozen is a full-time, on-site role based in Brooklyn, NY. This role will own day-to-day operations of the Frozen Production Facility and drive consistent output across all frozen manufacturing. Core responsibilities include production leadership, packaging, staffing, inventory and supply-chain optimization, logistics expertise, food-safety elevation, and full facility/equipment readiness. Our mandate is clear: take a high-growth disruptor brand’s production operation and turn it into a dominant, scalable food-manufacturing engine. Success in this role is designed to evolve into COO.

**Qualifications**

* Proven track record evolving an emerging brand into advanced, large-scale manufacturing success
* Proven blend of entrepreneurial grit and disciplined management systems
* Operations leadership experience in food manufacturing or closely related industry
* Strong KPI ownership, demand forecasting, data-driven decision-making, and ERP proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to coach teams, manage performance, and collaborate cross-functionally
* Solid knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP, and quality-assurance best practices
* Ideally experienced in developing and managing SQF certification
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma or similar mindset preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Food Science, or related field preferred

Pay: $150,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Food Manufacturing: 10 years (Required)
* SQF: 5 years (Required)
* Lean Manufacturing (Six Sigma): 3 years (Preferred)
* ERP systems: 1 year (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Brooklyn, NY 11232 (Required)

Work Location: In person

Description: 

We’re seeking a Plant Manager - Asphalt who’s ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America.

 

**Job Title:** Plant Manager - Asphalt **| Req ID:** 18651 | **HR Contact:** Fredric Victor THOMPSON| **Location:** Stoughton MA

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

 

The Plant Manager is accountable for the leadership, development & management of all functions of the HMA manufacturing business at this location. The Plant Manager will ensure lean staffing and oversee safe production to enable plant productivity and maintenance in an efficient manner, while producing quality products for customers. The primary focus will be on safety, compliance and optimum manufacturingmaximizing productivity at the lowest cost of production. Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and supervising the activities of one or more asphalt plants. The Plant Manager communicates goals to department employees and ensures that goals are achieved. Maximizes employee participation to achieve the desired team approach. Develops departmental personnel to enhance skills, improve responsiveness and promote business growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Coordinate the execution of general plant operations activities. Coordinate field management activities.
* Help coordinate activities such as transportation and receiving of product at the plant.
* Ensure that we produce quality products that meet or exceed customer expectations
* Inspect product quality ensuring all criteria meets plan. Recommend measures to improve production methods and equipment performance.
* Provides timely and accurate tickets for customers. Runs loader or dozer at bins and stock pile, and performs plant maintenance and housekeeping.
* Monitor, recommend, implements repairs and routine maintenance of equipment, buildings and grounds.
* Investigates abnormal operating events or equipment failures to determine cause; makes adjustments,repairs, and/or modifications as needed.
* Directly supervises 2 – 8 employees in the HMA division . Coach, train, mentor employees on the safe and efficient method of operating plant equipment. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees, planning, assigning and directing work rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
* Supports and assists personnel in achieving timely and
 
 efficient production schedules. Records employees’ time in online timekeeping system.
* Communicates and promotes safety, compliance and environmental requirements in alignment with company standards within production area. Monitors work performed and addresses situations that do not conform to standards.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.
 

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
 
**Education:** Bachelor's degree or 6 years of equivalent experience
 
**Required Work Experience:** Minimum of six years of production-related work experience. Related supervisory or group leader experience preferred.
 
**Required Technical Skills:** Basic computer skills with ability to enter information in SAP and time recording software and working with Microsoft Office applications

 

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved. Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators. Subject to applicable law, employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.
 

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary
* Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program
* Dress for your day
 

**Amrize is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**

*We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.*

**BUILDING INCLUSIVE WORKSPACES**
 
At Amrize, there is endless opportunity for you to play your part. Whether you’re in a technical, managerial, or frontline role, you can shape a career that works for you. We're seeking builders, creative thinkers and innovators. Come put your expertise to work while developing the knowledge and skills to drive your career forward. With us you’ll have the chance to build your ambition!

Amrize North America Inc. takes pride in our hiring processes and our commitment that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, ethnicity, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, citizenship, physical or mental disability, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. Amrize North America Inc, and its respective subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers, deciding all employment on the basis of qualification, merit and business need. Amrize Canada Inc. is committed to the principles of employment equity and encourages the applications from women, visible minorities, and persons with disabilities. Amrize North America Inc. participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request accommodation in order to apply for a position with us, please email recruiting-accommodations@amrize.com. This email address should only be used for accommodations and not general inquiries or resume submittals. In Ontario, our organization/business is committed to fulfilling our requirements under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Under the Act, accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

**PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 
The only way to apply for a position at Amrize is through our official Careers website. Be cautious of unsolicited offers or requests for information from other sources. Learn how to protect yourself from recruitment fraud here: Fraudulent Job Offers Policy

Segment: Operations

Rich’s, also known as Rich Products Corporation, is a family-owned food company dedicated to inspiring possibilities. From cakes and icings to pizza, appetizers and specialty toppings, our products are used in homes, restaurants and bakeries around the world. Beyond great food, our customers also gain insights to help them stay competitive, no matter their size. Our portfolio includes creative solutions geared at helping food industry professionals compete in foodservice, retail, in-store bakery, deli, and prepared foods, among others. With more than 13,500 associates working globally in 100 countries and annual sales of $5.9 billion, Rich’s is a global leader with a focus on everything that family makes possible. Rich’s®—Infinite Possibilities. One Family.

**Purpose Statement**
---------------------

The Plant Manager's responsibility is to provide leadership to all departments for overall vision and direction of the plant by way of guidance, direction, encouragement, training and development. Also developing and coaching managers and supervisors to excel to the peak of their performance levels. In addition to directing all managerial personnel to manage their departments and functional areas to meet the manufacturing plant’s operational and financial objectives while supporting the values, mission, vision, and priorities of Rich Products Corporation.

**Key Accountabilities and Outcomes**
-------------------------------------

* Full responsibility for the complete operation of the manufacturing facility.
* Ensures safe, efficient operation of the plant within the guidelines established by Rich Products and all governmental laws and regulations to include all food safety programs and auditing processes.
* Monitors production, inventory, safety, human resources, quality assurance, maintenance and sanitation programs.
* Plans capital projects, long range strategic planning, and succession planning.
* Promotes Lean Manufacturing concepts and leads the plant with Rich Products vision; is open to, and promotes change to continually improve and enhance the facility and workforce to stay ahead of the competition.
* Ensures ethical behavior in all aspects of managing the facility and its material and human resources.
* Responsibility for manufacturing facility’s Capital and operating budgets.
* Responsible for associate and leadership development, developing team skills, and creating a culture of engagement and continuous improvement.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Experience**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelors Degree in Business Management, Food Science, Engineering, Science or similar academic disciplines.
* 5-10 Years Experience at the Plant Management Position and 5-10 years in a supervisory and or management position with progressively more responsible positions.
* Knowledge of Food Safety, Associate Safety Programs/Systems HAACP, GMPs etc. Sanitation and Plant Maintenance and Continuous Improvement such as Lean Manufacturing and Total Productive Manufacturinng (TPM) would be definite assets.
* A Master’s in Business Administration is preferred but not required.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and cultural sensitivity required. Foreign Language skills as it relates to the facility’s demographics are a plus.
* Ability to manage a diverse staff of managerial personnel.
* Experience with self-directed teams/skill-based pay.

$162,450.00 - $270,750.00

Please contact Rich’s Associate Experience Network at hrhelp@rich.com if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process.

 

**BRINGING YOUR BEST SELF TO WORK.**
------------------------------------

As a family-owned company, caring for our associates—their whole selves—is a top priority. That’s why we provide benefits and tools to help our people balance the integration of work and life:

* Competitive compensation
* Health & financial benefits
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Family planning support
* Flexible work policy
* Associate resource groups
* Volunteering & community impact opportunities
* Holiday gatherings
* In-house taste tests (we are a food company after all)!

It’s all part of how we support our family of associates. ***Because in the company of family, all things are possible.***

----------------

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Leads multi facility (campus) or multi-modality operations. Leads the site(s) management team(s) driving the daily execution of all aspects of handling and processing Customer products. Responsible for ensuring adherence to all regulatory requirements. Responsible for management of site(s) Safety culture and program. Has P&L responsibility for the facility/facilities.

**What You'll Do as a Plant Manager**
-------------------------------------

Operational Excellence

* Responsible for development of Safety culture, programs and compliance. Leads Plant Safety
* Leader of Lean Steering Committee (LSC) responsible for the lean transformation of the plant
* Audits and improves SQDC board metrics and adjusts priorities based on countermeasure performance and business needs.
* Audits SQDC board and adjusts priorities based on countermeasure performance and business needs.
* Identifies and creates systems to visualize the flow of information and products allowing people to immediately detect and correct abnormal conditions.
* Communicates and manages capacity utilization to internal and external Customers.
* Responsible for adherence to all applicable operating regulations (FDA, ISO, OSHA, NRC, EPA, DOT)

People Leadership

* Drives a culture of positive employee relations, including responsiveness to safety, employee relations issues, disciplinary actions, communicating clear expectations and accountability processes, demonstrating effective leadership presence.
* Develops direct reports and ensures tools are in place to develop staff and succession planning.
* Owns employee engagement and action items to provide ongoing, positive change to site culture aligned with STERIS Business Imperatives.
* Responsible for employee performance management and corrective actions in conjunction with Human Resources.
* Provides final approval for recruiting, interviewing, hiring and onboarding.

Customer Relationship

* Regularly interfaces with Customers to ensure service levels and expectations are met.
* Partner with Sales leadership in conducting routine business reviews with Customers.
* Resolves escalated Customer issues from the sterilization process.
* Active involvement in Customer visits and Business Reviews.
* Interface with Sales on Customer and capacity management.
* Responsible for resolution of nonconformance resulting in Customer product reimbursement.

Delivering Results

* Ensures performance across a range of activities and metrics within their area at the facility/campus level
* Manage Safety Program to ensure safe working environment. No OSHA Recordable Injuries or Days
* Customer Service – Ensure Customer processing needs are exceeded from inbound receipt of product to return shipment.
* Improve accuracy during product processing to eliminate Customer product damage and quality related issues (NC/CC). Investigate Quality issues and corrective action development.
* Ensure adherence to Safety and Quality requirements while handling Customer products, operating equipment and performing routine job functions.
* Engage workforce through use of Lean Principles while seeking to improve Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost (SQDC). Development of Countermeasures and execution of Action Plans to improve daily performance.
* Develop operating budget and manage area expenses to ensure P&L targets are achieved.
* Recommend, submit and manage capital projects through completion.

**The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Necessary**
---------------------------------------------------

* 5 years of operations leadership/people management experience with a bachelor's degree OR 10 years of operations leadership/people management experience with a high school diploma / GED.
* 5 years of safety Culture development and management
* 2 years of budget preparation
* 2 years of working across plant locations and with corporate functions
* 5 years of driving diverse and complex agendas (Customer, employee, SQDC)
* 5 years of talent selection and development

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking a team-oriented, hands-on Plant Manager with a robust background in maintenance leadership. This role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, with a particular emphasis on developing and executing a world-class maintenance program at our mill in St. Maries, Idaho. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement, ensuring the facility meets production goals while maintaining the highest standards of equipment reliability and team development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the plant’s manufacturing and maintenance operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable production.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and proactive maintenance programs, including planning, scheduling, and execution.
* Direct and develop a multidisciplinary team, including Maintenance Planners, Millwrights, Electricians, Mechanics, and Production Supervisors.
* Foster a “Safety First” culture, ensuring compliance with all safety and environmental regulations and serving as a role model for safe industrial behavior.
* Collaborate with other departments (Finance, HR, Sales, Marketing, Resources) to align plant performance with company goals and market demands.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices in manufacturing and maintenance to optimize resources and processes.
* Lead and support improvement projects, including research, cost analysis, financial justification, and project management from conception to completion.
* Manage key performance indicators for maintenance and production, such as safety compliance, PM completion, downtime, overtime, expense controls, and plant cleanliness.
* Develop and retain high-performing teams through effective communication, training, and empowerment.
* Build strong relationships across the organization, ensuring active communication and teamwork.
* Utilize modern maintenance management tools (e.g., CMMS, AutoCAD, MS Suite) and interpret technical documents (e.g., blueprints).

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in plant management or senior manufacturing leadership, with a strong track record in maintenance supervision and program development.
* Minimum of five years in maintenance leadership, with hands-on experience in preventive, predictive, and proactive maintenance.
* Strong technical skills in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and strong understanding of PLC systems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams in a continuous improvement environment.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communicator, able to set clear expectations and drive accountability.
* Experience with process optimization.
* Business acumen to manage budgets, control costs, and justify investments.
* High school diploma required; college-level education in a related field preferred.

new_roles.description:
**Job Details:**

**Summary**

This position is responsible for all functional areas of a poultry processing plant, including the efficient operation of three production shifts, maintenance, personnel safety, shipping and receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, and process improvement. The role also includes motivating managers to provide guidance and development programs that enhance employee skill levels, resolving issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods, and reviewing cost and performance data to identify areas for improvement.

Additional responsibilities include compiling monthly expense and efficiency reports, promoting and explaining Total Quality Management (TQM) philosophy to employees, and obtaining approval for and executing all plant capital improvement projects. This position is responsible for facilitating Talent Mapping and Succession Planning programs and supporting retention initiatives. The role is also accountable for food safety, food quality, and product legality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Direct and oversee all functional areas of a poultry processing plant.
* Ensure the efficient operation of three production shifts, including maintenance, personnel safety, shipping and receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, and process improvement activities.
* Motivate and support managers in providing guidance and development programs to enhance employee skills and performance.
* Resolve issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods.
* Analyze cost and performance data to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* Compile and present monthly expense and efficiency reports.
* Promote and communicate the principles of Total Quality Management (TQM) throughout the facility.
* Obtain approval for and execute all plant capital improvement projects.
* Facilitate Talent Mapping and Succession Planning programs.
* Support employee retention initiatives.
* Maintain accountability for food safety, food quality, and product legality.
* Initiate and implement improvements across all phases of production.
* Assist in identifying, evaluating, and correcting operational problems.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as needed.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, typically acquired through four years of college-level study in a general professional or technical field.

**Experience**

* Eight (8) or more years of progressive leadership experience required.
* Experience in the poultry industry or the food processing industry preferred.

**Computer Skills**

* General knowledge of computer applications used in plant operations, including Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Outlook
* Working knowledge of SAP systems preferred.

**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Travel**

* Ability to travel approximately 6 to 11 times per year.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Responsible for managing multiple groups of personnel performing diverse tasks and activities across more than one department.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager I
new_roles.description:
**Plant Manager I**

850 W Gowen Rd, Boise, ID 83705, USA

Full-time

**Job Description**

Norco is currently seeking an individual to fill our Plant Manager I position. The Plant Manager I is accountable for the overall safe, compliant, reliable, efficient, and financially responsible operation of the production facility. The position establishes facility strategy and operating priorities, develops the leadership team, allocates resources, manages operational and regulatory risk, drives performance, and leads long-term improvement to support production capacity, customer service, and business continuity. Other responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Plant Leadership and Strategy**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the production facility and assigned support functions.
* Establish facility goals, staffing plans, operating priorities, budgets, capital priorities, reliability priorities, and improvement strategies.
* Maintain overall facility accountability for employee safety, product quality, regulatory compliance, customer service, production capacity, equipment reliability, operating cost, inventory control, and business continuity.
 

**Leadership Development and Organizational Capability**

* Build, direct, and develop the plant leadership team; establish clear accountability for supervisors and managers; assess leadership effectiveness; and maintain succession and development plans for critical facility roles.
* Approve or recommend hiring, promotion, compensation, discipline, and termination decisions within assigned authority.

**Operational and Financial Performance**

* Review plant performance through KPI's, safety, quality, production, service, labor, training, inventory, maintenance, downtime, and financial measures.
* Require recovery plans and corrective action when plant or department performance does not meet expectations.
* Plan and request approval for operating expenditures, capital projects, staffing changes, and other resources needed to meet business requirements.
* Balance production capacity, service requirements, operating cost, equipment reliability, inventory, and plant resources when making operating decisions.
* Approve major operating commitments and significant resource decisions within assigned authority.

**Safety, Quality, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure operations are conducted in accordance with applicable company safety rules, procedures, work instructions, quality requirements, and assigned personal protective equipment requirements.
* Ensure required production and regulated records receive review and approval by properly trained and authorized personnel.
* Lead or oversee significant incidents, root-cause analyses, corrective actions, audit responses, product-quality events, regulatory interactions, service disruptions, and business-continuity responses. 
 Cross-Functional Leadership
* Coordinate significant facility matters with Gas Operations, Quality, Safety, Human Resources, Sales, Customer Service, Distribution, Maintenance, Procurement, Finance, Information Technology, and branch leadership.
* Communicate plant risks, performance, operating constraints, resource needs, and significant decisions clearly and promptly to appropriate stakeholders.
* Participate in company planning, leadership meetings, management reviews, emergency response, and special projects.
* Maintain sufficient technical knowledge to evaluate operating risk and make informed management decisions.
* Stay informed of and adhere to company policies and procedures.

**Supervision**

* Incumbent works under general supervision and exercises substantial independent judgment within established company policies, approved budgets, regulatory requirements, and assigned authority.

**Organizational Role**

* Manager - plans and assigns work to accomplish facility and departmental goals; responsible for leadership, hiring, employee development, performance management, resource allocation, and operating outcomes for assigned employees and functions.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Five years of progressively responsible experience in production, manufacturing, compressed gas, chemical processing, distribution, or a related operational environment.
* Three years of successful experience leading supervisors, departments, or comparable operational workgroups.
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
* Valid driver's license.
* Forklift certification or ability to become certified if required.
* Comprehensive understanding of production leadership, safety management, quality systems, regulatory compliance, operating risk, budgeting, capital planning, and resource allocation.
* Working knowledge of industrial, medical, specialty, and fuel gases; cylinders; production equipment; cylinder maintenance; material handling; loading; and related plant operations.
* Ability to lead managers and supervisors, establish accountability, develop employees, and support succession planning.
* Strong judgment regarding safety, regulatory, legal, operational, customer-service, reputational, and financial risk.
* Excellent organizational, decision-making, root-cause analysis, change-management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial measures and translate findings into effective priorities and corrective actions.
* Ability to communicate concisely with employees, branch personnel, company leadership, customers, contractors, auditors, and regulators.
* Ability to safely handle compressed gas cylinders and use material-handling aids as required.

**Preferred Education and Experience**:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, physical science, operations management, or a related field.
* Experience in compressed gas production, medical gas production, specialty gas operations, fuel gas operations, cylinder maintenance, or regulated manufacturing.
* Experience with quality assurance, audits, regulated documentation, budgets, capital projects, reliability, and continuous improvement.

**Additional information**

Norco offers a competitive compensation/benefit package, including:

* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Health, Vision and Dental Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Medical and Dependent Care Flex Accounts (FSA)
* Life Insurance provided at no cost to employee by Norco
* Supplemental Accident, Disease, and Life Insurance options
* Employee Tuition Reimbursement
* 401(k) with Employer Matching
* Employee Discount on products sold by Norco

**Company Description**

Founded in 1948, Norco is headquartered in Boise, Idaho and has more than 70 branches in Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Nevada, Washington, Utah and Wyoming. As a family and employee owned company we operate the nation's largest independent gas manufacturer/distributor of welding, safety, medical equipment and supplies. Norco is proud to be among the thousands of privately-owned businesses nationwide that offer their employees a meaningful stake in the business through employee stock ownership (ESOP).

At Norco we share a common mission: "Serving You Better." Treating customers, suppliers and each other with respect and dignity is our top priority. We work hard every day to serve others and create rich lives for our employees, their families, and the communities where we work and live.

**Norco, Inc is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer**

Norco provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

**Norco, Inc is a Drug-Free workplace.**

new_roles.description:
**Pacific Coast Producers |** Full-Time | On-Site | Exempt 
**Salary Range:** $160,000- $200,000 /year (based on experience)

**Pacific Coast Producers** (PCP), a growing agricultural cooperative with food production facilities across the West Coast, is seeking an experienced and strategic **Plant Manager** to lead our Production Facility **in Lodi, CA**. PCP is dedicated to investing in its people and fostering a culture of service, where each employee can do their best to make affordable, high-quality food for customers across North America.

Join our legacy of talented people working together to innovate and lead our industry. As a member of PCP, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes top-quality, medical, dental, and vision insurance, generous paid time off, and a retirement savings plan to help secure your future.

The Plant Manager will have overall accountability for directing and managing plant operations to meet quality, food safety, and customer requirements in a safe, cost-effective, and timely manner. The plant employs over 800 employees during the processing season and maintains an experienced year-round staff. The Plant Manager reports directly to the Director of Operations.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production
* Develop and execute production plans aligned with raw material supply, demand, labor, and plant capacity
* Drive performance against key metrics including safety, quality, throughput, and cost
* Own operating and capital budgets; analyzing performance and implementing corrective actions
* Champion food safety, environmental compliance, and regulatory adherence (OSHA, FDA, SQF, HACCP, HARPC, GMPs)
* Build, coach, and develop strong teams through clear expectations and consistent leadership
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, reliability, and profitability
* Partner effectively with union leadership to maintain a positive and productive work environment
* Oversee capital projects and internal investments to support future growth and operational excellence

**What You Bring to the Team:**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing including aseptic processing, canning, or similar method.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field
* Proven ability to lead large teams in a fast-paced, unionized setting
* Proven experience with process flows, automated controls, review of AutoCAD drawings, and dealing with industrial processing equipment vendors and mechanical contractors.
* Strong operational and financial acumen, including budgeting and performance analysis
* Demonstrated success driving continuous improvement and leading change
* Deep understanding of food safety systems and regulatory requirements (GFSI, HACCP, HARPC, FDA, OSHA)
* Hands-on leadership style with strong problem-solving capability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under tight timelines
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization

**Why Join PCP?**

At PCP, we take care of our people. Here are just a few of the benefits full-time employees enjoy:

* **Competitive pay** with opportunities for advancement.
* **This position is eligible for our annual profit-sharing bonus program**.
* **Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, starting the first of the month after you join us.**
* **Retirement plans** to support your long-term security.
* **Paid time off** including vacation, holidays, parental leave, sick leave, and bereavement.
* **Life and disability insurance** plus an Employee Assistance Program.
* **Development opportunities** through online courses, classroom training, and on-the-job growth.
* The stability of a **farmer-owned cooperative** with more than 50 years of success.
* A mission-driven culture focused on **feeding families across North America.**

**Salary Range: $160,000 - $200,000/year (based on experience).** This is a **full-time, on-site** role based at our production facility Lodi, CA.

The base salary range reflects the reasonable expectation for what the company anticipates paying for this role at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on factors including, but not limited to:

* Relevant skills, education, and experience
* Job-related qualifications and certifications
* Internal pay equity
* Market conditions and business needs

**Sponsorship:** This role is not eligible for current or future visa sponsorship.

**About PCP Summary**

Founded in 1971, Pacific Coast Producers is owned by more than 165 family farmers who cultivate and deliver a diverse range of crops including tomatoes, peaches, pears, grapes, cherries, and more. Our cooperative operates multiple processing and packaging facilities across the West Coast, supplying top-quality products to grocery retailers and foodservice distributors throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Our Lodi Production facility is a bustling hub where delicious apples, peaches, and apricots are transformed into high-quality products. The facility is equipped with advanced machinery and cutting-edge technology, enabling efficient and precise sorting, peeling, and slicing of the fruits. Meticulous attention is paid to every step of the process, ensuring that only the finest fruits make their way into the final products.

Nestled in the heart of San Joaquin County and just a short 45-minute drive from Sacramento, our Production Facility is located in the charming city of Lodi, CA. Lodi is renowned for its rich history in winemaking and agriculture, as well as its vibrant downtown area and close-knit community. With a great quality of life, Lodi offers a welcoming environment to those seeking a relaxed and enjoyable lifestyle.

**AA/EEO Policy Statement**

Pacific Coast Producers is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. No employee or applicant will be discriminated against in any condition of employment because of race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Plant Manager position reports to Principal.

This full-time, salaried position requires excellent technology and communication skills to facilitate all and any operations

the witness and the behavior of all employees that give the distinctive character to Catholic schools. Information

Church that employees of Catholic institutions consider their lived-faith and their Christian life-style just as important as

their professional credentials.
