Managerof Mary Help of Christian School shall meet the following employment criteria:

**Primary Responsibilities**

 be diligent in learning the Salesian Educational Philosophy and dedicated in its implementation and application

 maintain the highest level of confidentiality

 Good organization skills

 Good time management

 cultivate attitudes and skills of one’s self, students and fellow employees for life-long learning

 Confident and effective communication skills

 Excellent knowledge and hands on experience of everything pertaining school operations and security

 Provide leadership for the successful day-to-day operation of the facility

 Review schedules and insure highest efficiency and safety for faculty, staff and student body

 Assist in monitoring operation expenses and research ways to reduce costs while maintaining efficiency and
 
quality

staff is aware of safety policies to provide a safe workplace for our employees and for our faculty, staff and

student body

 Develop and maintain a system for inventory levels and orderly control flow of maintenance equipment, and
 
supplies

 Develop and maintain a safety/housekeeping system with timely communication

 Conduct performance evaluation and suggest areas of needed training and/or guidance for custodians and
 
maintenance employees

 Encourage and promote an attitude of continuous improvement

 Observe and suggest to administration way to improve efficiency and enhance a quality campus

 Interface with Human Resources in keeping OSHA training and school licenses current for fire, swimming pool,
 
kitchen, plumbing, vehicles, trailers etc.

**Minimum Requirements**

 Education, knowledge, experience and an attitude of passionate learning in order to remain updated in a fast

 Resume (required)

 Service Records (if you have previous school experience)

 Ability to communicate effectively in verbal and written form in Spanish and English

 Ability to handle stressful situations in a calm manner

 All health requirements, testing and background clearance required by the Diocese

 Ability to maintain emotional control under stress

new_roles.description:
Linde Gas & Equipment Inc.

**Plant Manager**

Beckley, WV, United States | req34508 Work Schedule: 1st Shift

**What you will enjoy doing\***

* You will provide leadership and direction for a team of entry-level production employees to ensure customer demand is consistently met
* Coordinate daily production activities and distribution requirements, including local delivery routes and shuttle scheduling
* You will lead reliability, compliance, quality, and safety initiatives to meet governmental and environmental regulations Ensure temployees are trained and committed to Linde Safety and Quality systems, woring closely with the Compliance Manager to coordinate training
* Monitor production performance and manpower levels to maintain efficiency, anticipate problems, and develop contingencies
* Identify operational challenges and lead improvement efforts related to production processes, shift scheduling, and training; report progress and findings to plant management
* You will manage and escalate equipment and product quality issues, maintaining adequate inventory of production supplies and support 5S and Lean Projects and hazardous waste activities, continuously identifying ways to reduce plant operating costs through Operational Excellence strategies

**What makes you great**

* Bachelor's degree is preferred; high school diploma or GED is required in this role
* You have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in an industrial plant environment
* More than five (5+) years of experience in Driver, operations, distribution or quality roles
* You have at least three (3) years of experience leading and developing employees
* Willingness to work in a unionized Environment is required

**Why you will love working with us**

Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet.
 
 
Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.

**What we offer you!**

At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless. 
 
Linde offers competitive compensation and an outstanding benefits package. Enjoy access to health, dental, disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and vacation, an employee discount program, and opportunities for educational and professional growth. Additional compensation may vary depending on the position and organizational level. Build your future with us while making an impact every day!

**Have we inspired you? Let´s talk about it**

We are looking forward to receiving your complete application.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law. 
 
Linde Gas & Equipment Inc. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development. 
 

* The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Therefore employees assigned may be required to perform additional job tasks required by the manager.

**About Us:**

TreeHouse Foods is a leading manufacturer of private label packaged foods and beverages, operating a network of over 20 production facilities and several corporate offices across the United States and Canada. At TreeHouse Foods, our commitment to excellence extends beyond our products and revolves around our people. We are investing in talent and creating a performance-based culture where employees can do their best work and develop their careers, directly impacting our mission to make high quality, affordable food for our customers, communities, and families. We embrace change, prioritize continuous learning, and foster collaboration, transparency, and healthy debate. Together, we set each other up for success to achieve enterprise-wide goals.

**What You Gain:**

* Competitive compensation and benefits program with no waiting period – you’re eligible from your first day!
* 401(k) program with 5% employer match and 100% vesting as soon as you enroll.
* Comprehensive paid time off opportunities, including immediate access to four weeks of vacation, five sick days, parental leave and 11 company holidays (including two floating holidays).

**Job Description:**

***About the Role:***

 

We are seeking a Plant Manager for our Cambridge, MD, facility, a leading manufacturer of quality aseptic products. This role is responsible for providing overall leadership and accountability for plant operations with a strong focus on delivering results. In partnership with the site leadership team, the Plant Manager will drive employee engagement, safety, quality, customer service, continuous improvement, cost management, and production performance to meet or exceed business objectives. The successful candidate will identify and implement strategic opportunities to improve operational efficiency, safety, throughput, productivity, schedule attainment, cost reduction, and product quality while fostering a positive and high-performing work environment.

 

***You will add value to this role by performing various functions including, but not limited to:***

* Providing coaching and leadership to team members in the areas of employee engagement, safety, quality, customer service, continuous improvement, cost, and equipment reliability to elevate the team’s performance.
* Promoting a safety culture and ensuring adherence to all health and safety policies/protocols.
* Leading the development, execution, and monitoring of the operations strategy in line with the overall operational objectives to achieve safety, quality and performance improvement and ensure achievement of manufacturing goals.
* Leading the continuous improvement program to deliver opportunities in cost, quality, food safety and service.
* Utilizing available data including OEE, line speed target, and efficiency and process data to continuously improve productivity, uptime, and reliability.
* Coordinating manufacturing activities with all other functions of the organization and suppliers to obtain optimum production and utilization of human resources, machines, and equipment.
Contribute to the development and execution of strategic plant-wide initiatives. 

 

***Important Details:***

The anticipated compensation for this position ranges from $154,700.00 - 232,100.00 USD annually. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics and business or organizational needs. For certain roles, the successful candidate may be eligible for annual discretionary merit compensation award, bonus and equity pay. 

 

***You’ll fit right in if you have:***

* High school diploma or equivalent is required; Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, industrial technology, or related field is preferred.
* Minimum of five years of leadership experience in a production or food manufacturing environment.

new_roles.description:
R10104082 Plant Manager (Open)

Location:

Carnegie, PA

**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the unique perspectives of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders, and cultures across the world. We believe that a variety of backgrounds makes our team stronger and more innovative.

**At Airgas, we RESPECT, HONOR and VALUE diversity.**
=====================================================

 

**Airgas is Hiring for a Plant Manager in Carnegie, PA**
========================================================

 

***We are looking for you !***

 

* **Comprehensive Family Benefits:** Airgas offers a full benefits package designed to support your whole life, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance.
* **Support for Parents:** We offer a 14-week paid child birth benefit to support growing families.
* **Future Security:** 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, Tuition Assistance, Paid Holidays, Vacation, and Sick time.
* **Early Access:** Your benefits start after just 30 days of employment.

 

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading and empowering the team engaged in producing and repackaging of compressed and liquid gases into cylinders, correcting unsafe acts or conditions without delay, and aligning daily responsibilities with team members according to customer needs, current stock levels and team strengths.

* Ensures the safe operation and maintenance of the plant for pumping or repackaging of gases into cylinders while ensuring compliance with all federal, state, local and company policies, procedures, regulations and laws. Maintains a neat, clean and orderly plant appearance.
* Studies production schedules and estimates team-hour requirements for completion of job assignments. Establishes and/or adjusts work procedures collaboratively to meet production schedules.
* Partners with the team to enhance production methods, equipment performance, and product quality. Adapts workflows and use of equipment to support team productivity and well-being.
* Ensures all safety rules are strictly observed and safety training is regularly scheduled, conducted and documented. Interpret company policies to team members and foster a culture of safety adherence.
* Ensures all injuries and accidents are properly investigated and reported within 24 hours.
* Analyzes and resolves, or partners with team members in solving, work related problems. Supports career growth, internal movement, and constructive performance management. Ensures associate issues, grievances, etc. are effectively handled.
* Mentors and guides operational leaders to cultivate effective leadership. Design collaborative initiatives to inspire and engage the team to achieve goals. Provides coaching and corrective action promptly, to ensure that team members receiving feedback are supported to meet shared performance goals.
* Onboards new team members and supports cross-functional learning to continue production during personnel shortages.
* Maintains time and production records and approves overtime when essential, while keeping overtime at acceptable levels.
* Collaborates with outside sales to ensure order accuracy and properly scheduled customer deliveries by Airgas trucks.
* Monitors SAP reports daily such as open order/delivery reports, billing and delivery block reports and open Purchase Order (PO) reports.
* Oversees employee development in procedural areas such as following all Airgas Standard Operating Procedures (SOPS) and safety regulations.
* Run recurring orders for the next day's deliveries.
* Route all the trucks and PGI tickets.
* Complete Daily Cycle Counts.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
----------------------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or GED
* A total of five (5) years of industry experience to include a minimum of two (2) years of demonstrated experience working in a supervisory/leadership role. Prefer prior experience with compressed/packaged gases.

**Prefered Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree
* Prior experience utilizing SAP preferred.
* Intermediate knowledge of Google suite applications
* Strong analytical skills and a thorough understanding of how to leverage metrics and related tools to improve production efficiency and effectiveness.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Communication skills that ensure a smooth flow of information between self and others through clear speaking and writing, encouragement of open expression of ideas, and effective listening.

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deal effectively with others in both favorable and unfavorable situations regardless of status of position. Accepts cultural diversity and establishes effective working relationships.
* Demonstrated knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division in all units of measure using whole numbers, fractions and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratios, and percent.

* Lives by Airgas safety programs, OSHA, and all related rules, regulations, procedures which are applicable to this position’s responsibilities

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Benefits**

We care about and support our Airgas Families. This is evident not only through our competitive compensation but also through a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision plans, short-term and long-term disability, life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), pre-tax commuter transportation benefit, parental leave, vacation, sick time, floating holidays, jury duty and funeral/bereavement leave, and paid holidays for all eligible full-time employees.

Additionally, we offer our eligible employees a 401k plan with company matching funds, tuition reimbursement, discounted college tuition for eligible employees’ dependents, and an Airgas Scholarship Program for dependent children.

Associates who are members of collective bargaining units should review their bargaining agreement to determine whether they are eligible for some or all of the benefits described here and to see any special terms or conditions for eligibility.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Your DIFFERENCES enhance our PERFORMANCE**

At Airgas, we are committed to building a workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability or any other protected characteristic. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**About Airgas**

Airgas, an Air Liquide company, is a leading U.S. supplier of industrial, medical and specialty gases, as well as hardgoods and related products; one of the largest U.S. suppliers of safety products; and a leading U.S. supplier of ammonia products and process chemicals. Through the passion and diversity of its 18,000 associates, Airgas fosters a culture of safety, customer success, sustainability and innovation. Airgas associates are empowered to share ideas, take initiative and make decisions.

Airgas is a subsidiary of Air Liquide, a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare. Present in 60 countries with approximately 66,500 employees, Air Liquide serves more than 4 million customers and patients.

Join us for a stimulating experience: At Airgas, you matter and so does the work you do. As a member of our team, you play an important role in the success of your team, making sure our products are created sustainably and delivered safely and efficiently. In turn, you’ll find a welcoming workplace where you’re valued for who you are and where you can fill your potential while growing a fulfilling career — whatever path you choose.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Equal Employment Opportunity Information**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Airgas, an Air Liquide Company is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973.

Airgas does not discriminate against qualified applicants with disabilities, and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to the known disabilities of such individuals so as to ensure equal access to benefits and privileges of employment. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us by email at us-accommodationrequest@airgas.com.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

new_roles.description:
**Location:**

Jefferson City, Missouri, United States of America

**Job ID:**

R0150590

**Date Posted:**

2026-11-10

**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY USA INC

**Profession (Job Category):**

Production & Skilled Trades

**Job Schedule:**

Full time

**Remote:**

No

**Job Description:**

Hitachi Energy is recruiting for a Director of Operations. The role will be based in Jefferson City, Missouri manufacturing plant. This is Hitachi Energy's largest plant globally and we will offer relocation assistance. The role will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing all operational activities to ensure efficiency, productivity, and profitability across designated operational manufacturing value stream. This role requires a strategic leader capable of driving continuous improvement and fostering a culture of operational excellence.
 
 
Job Responsibilities
 
 

* Develop and implement operational strategies aligned with Hitachi's overall business objectives.
* Optimize workflows, processes, and systems to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions to ensure targets are met or exceeded.
* Oversee budget planning, staffing, and management for operational departments, ensuring fiscal responsibility.
* Drive ITM (continuous improvement) initiatives through the adoption of ITM methodologies and best practices.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Engineering, Quality, HSSE, Process Engineering and downstream production departments.
* Develop and mentor operational teams, fostering a high-performance culture and promoting professional growth.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant industry regulations, quality standards, and company policies.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks, implementing robust contingency plans.

 
Job Qualifications
 
 

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in operations management, with at least 5 years in a senior people leadership role within a large-scale manufacturing organization.
* Proven track record of successfully leading and optimizing complex operational processes.
* Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, production planning, and quality control principles.
* Demonstrated experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and motivate diverse teams.
* Proficiency in enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and other operational software.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in budget management and cost control.

***Equal Employment Opportunity*** ***(EEO)-Females/Minorities/Protected*** ***Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities***

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

**Hitachi is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including females, minorities, protected veterans, and individuals**

**with disabilities.**

 

**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Protected veterans and qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. new_roles.title: Director of Product Management & Global Operations
new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

Here at Thermo Fisher Scientific, our industry-leading scale means unparalleled commercial reach, unique customer access, and a global footprint. Our broad customer base—from research and clinical laboratories to commercial manufacturing—enables you to make a meaningful impact every day. Join our team and help build the capabilities that enable exceptional customer service across one of the world's largest scientific organizations.

**Location**: On-site in Tewksbury, MA is highly preferred; *potential* flexibility for remote candidates aligned to Eastern Time Zone. Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**Position Summary**

The **Director of Product Management & Global Operations** is responsible for defining and advancing the global capabilities that enable consistent, scalable, and industry-leading service delivery across Thermo Fisher Scientific's global service organization.

Reporting into this role are the leaders responsible for Service Product Management, Service Platforms, and our Global Technical Support leaders representing a global organization of approximately 100 colleagues.

This leader establishes the strategy, governance, and operational frameworks that enable service excellence through standardized processes, knowledge management, digital service platforms, technical support, escalation management, and service lifecycle governance. Working across Product Management, Engineering, Digital, Commercial, Quality, and Regional Service organizations, the Global Service Capability Leader ensures service teams worldwide have the tools, processes, knowledge, and capabilities needed to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Service Capability Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy for service capabilities aligned with business growth objectives.
* Develop enterprise standards that improve service consistency, efficiency, and customer experience across all regions.
* Build scalable operational frameworks supporting future growth and digital transformation.
* Establish governance for global service capabilities and operational excellence initiatives.

**Service Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the global governance of service lifecycle management from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End-of-Life (EOL).
* Ensure global service readiness for new products, software, and technologies.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to establish supportability requirements early in product development.
* Standardize lifecycle planning, service documentation, training, spare parts readiness, and support models.

**Knowledge Management & Service Enablement**

* Own the global knowledge management strategy supporting service engineers and technical support organizations.
* Develop standardized technical content, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and digital knowledge assets.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles to improve service effectiveness.
* Ensure service knowledge remains accurate, accessible, and continuously improved.

**Technical Support & Escalation Management**

* Lead the global technical support organization responsible for advanced troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Establish enterprise escalation governance for complex customer and product issues.
* Drive root cause analysis in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Product teams.
* Ensure lessons learned from escalations translate into improved products, documentation, and service processes.

**Service Platforms & Digital Enablement**

* Lead strategy and adoption for global service platforms and digital service technologies.
* Partner with Digital and IT organizations to define the future roadmap for service enablement platforms.
* Drive adoption of field service technologies, analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Ensure platforms support efficient, standardized service execution globally.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Build leadership capability across Service Product Management, Technical Support, Service Platforms, and Service Operations.
* Foster a collaborative, customer-focused culture emphasizing accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Champion organizational development, succession planning, and talent growth across the global service capability organization.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field required.
* MBA or Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global service organizations, technical support, customer success, or operational excellence.
* Experience leading enterprise service capabilities within complex global matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success building global operating models and scalable service capabilities.
* Strong understanding of service lifecycle management, technical support, knowledge management, and digital service technologies.
* Experience leading organizational transformation and enterprise change initiatives.
* Financial and operational management experience, including forecasting, investment prioritization, and productivity improvement.

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Massachusetts is $165,000.00–$200,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

new_roles.title: Director of Operations (Mobile Devices)
new_roles.description:
We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Director of Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) Operations to lead and optimize our end-to-end CPO operations. This executive leadership role is responsible for driving operational excellence, quality, profitability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across multiple functions, including demand planning, production and repair operations, new product introduction, customer implementations, service delivery, and product lifecycle management. The ideal candidate is a proven operations leader with experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, or refurbishment environments. This individual will leverage Lean Six Sigma methodologies, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional leadership to deliver scalable processes, exceptional customer outcomes, and sustained business growth.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility, with occasional travel (~10%).

**What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?**

* Lead all aspects of CPO operations, ensuring high levels of quality, service, productivity, and profitability
* Develop and execute short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with business objectives
* Establish policies, procedures, and performance standards that drive operational excellence and accountability
* Oversee demand planning, operations planning and control, production processes, repair operations, parts reclamation, customer implementations, system support, and customer service functions
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma principles and best practices
* Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance programs that improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance customer satisfaction
* Partner with Product Development and Engineering teams to support new product introductions and operational readiness
* Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, improve scalability, and enhance operational performance
* Own operational financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and profitability analysis
* Evaluate business opportunities and operational investments through financial modeling and data-driven analysis
* Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions to achieve business goals
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead high-performing teams
* Establish performance expectations, succession planning, and employee development strategies
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Serve as the primary operational partner for internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Resolve operational, product, system, and customer-related issues while maintaining strong client relationships
* Collaborate across departments to successfully deliver strategic initiatives and operational improvements
* Present recommendations, business cases, and operational updates to leadership teams and executive audiences
* Support the development, launch, and operational integration of new products and services
* Drive ongoing product profitability, compliance, and lifecycle performance
* Partner with key stakeholders to identify and implement innovative solutions that support business growth

**What are the requirements needed for this position?**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 6+ years of progressive leadership experience managing complex manufacturing, repair, refurbishment, or operations environments
* Strong experience in demand planning, production planning, procurement, materials management, and new product introduction
* Proven success leading process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies
* Advanced analytical and financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and operational performance management
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, trend analysis, reporting, and data visualization
* Experience with project management, resource planning, and systems implementation
* Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
* Strong problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making

**What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?**

* Experience using AI tools and automation technologies to improve business processes and operational efficiency
* Background in technical, mechanical, electronics repair, refurbishment, or manufacturing environments
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher
* Experience working within ISO and OSHA-regulated environments
* Experience with Oracle ERP systems
* Experience supporting wireless or consumer electronics products

new_roles.description:
**Date Posted:**

2026-11-10

**Country:**

United States of America

**Location:**

US-RI-PORTSMOUTH-PS1 ~ 1847 W Main Rd ~ NIMITZ BLDG

**Position Role Type:**

Onsite

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Confidential

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon has an opening for a Sr. Production Control Lead supporting our Undersea Factory in our Portsmouth, RI facility. The successful candidate has experience with Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems in a manufacturing environment and utilizes data-driven decision making to enable effective material and workforce forecasting. This role requires daily interaction with cross functional teams, programs, and business units to maintain and meet organizational goals and objectives. These groups include planning, production control, operations, quality, and manufacturing/test/design engineering.

**What You Will Do**

* Managing a highly visible area with 6 production control professionals reporting into this position.
* Set strategic vision, direction and plan to execute on short to medium term program and functional strategies and initiatives.
* Material Availability Analysis, Tracking, and Reporting.
* Manage Kit Readiness including working with cross-functional team in BOM, Material Master, Process Engineering, Operations, and Document Control.
* Releasing production schedules in multiple tools through the MRP system and confirming in shop floor system.
* Coordinates kitting process with multiple stores and consolidation areas.
* Provide production floor support including replacement part management, shop floor material staging, Work in Progress (WIP) movement through shared resource areas, completion of units in shop floor and MRP system, delivery to next step (inventory or shipment), and meeting MRP schedule.
* Control the physical disposition of nonconforming or specially handled material including Return to Vendor, purged material, WIP STOP per contractual restrictions, and configuration of components/sub-assemblies as required.
* Maintain integrity of the shop floor, MRP, and inventory systems through key performance metrics.
* Process piece part movement to support internal build requirements through subcontractors, internal shared resources, and other Raytheon Technologies facilities.
* This position is an onsite role in our Portsmouth, RI facility.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years experience.
* Experience in Production Control, Supply Chain, Planning, Logistics, Scheduling, Operations, Manufacturing, or other production driven environments within manufacturing.
* Experience with MRP/ERP systems.
* Experience leading daily team operations and/or comparable leadership experience.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience leading in a Department of Defense (DoD) environment.
* Experience in Special Program Access and other business systems, including shop floor data systems.
* Experience in Six Sigma, CORE, Lean Manufacturing processes, diagnostics, and continuous improvement.
* Experience driving financial performance, cost reduction, staffing, and budgeting.

**What We Offer**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

* **Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role.**
 + **Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
* **Clearance Information:** This position requires a security clearance. **DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA CAS)**, an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978.htm

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Training & Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team:**

**The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.**

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally. You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

**You Will**

* Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
* Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
* Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
* Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
* Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
* Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

**Who you Are**

* You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
* You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
* You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
* You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
* Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
* Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
* Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
* Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
* Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
* Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
* Paid Time Off
* Retirement Plans
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Education Benefits
* Family Care Benefits
* Commuter Transit Program
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. new_roles.title: Senior Manager Quality Control, Lab Operations
new_roles.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Rensselaer
* Req ID:R51414
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Senior Manager Quality Control (QC) Lab Operations to support our teams at our new highly automated drug substance manufacturing facility. The Senior Manager, QC Lab Operations leads a team who supports the technical and operational lifecycle of assigned QC laboratories, including new lab builds, fit-outs, relocations; new technology implementation; and continuous capability upgrades. The role sets strategy for lab operations, accounting for testing demand, equipment utilization, capacity, sample and data flow, and staffing. They partner with internal partners to resolve cross-functional conflicts and schedule, resource, and compliance risks. The role ensures changes meet FDA cGMP requirements and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Represents the team during regulatory inspections and internal audits. Oversees hiring, training, performance management, and development of team members while standardizing lab implementation practices across sites.

**When & where:**

* Location: Rensselaer, New York, United States
* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
* Travel: 50% domestic- mostly capital region

**Discover your role:**

* Lead and develop a larger team, own organizational design, headcount planning, and workforce strategy for QC lab technology and facilities delivery
* Build the leadership pipeline through talent calibration and stretch assignments; set the competency framework managers apply, and hold them accountable for team performance, coaching quality, and employee relations outcomes
* Ensure training compliance and a site-wide skills strategy (equipment qualification, CSV, LIMS and CDS integration, GMP authorship); identify capability gaps
* Lead the integrated portfolio of lab builds, technology implementations, and upgrades, with accountability for capital and project spend, schedule, and resource allocation
* Set prioritization criteria, balance resources across managers’ portfolios, and resolve cross-portfolio conflicts; sponsor business cases and scope trade-off recommendations tied to site strategy
* Serve as QC’s design authority for lab technology delivery; set standards for URS content, assay-to-space and material flow design, and lab bus, LIMS, and CDS integration so data integrity is designed in rather than remediated later
* Represent QC Lab Operations at executive and cross-functional forums on design, vendor strategy, and value engineering; own the QC position on any scope reduction
* Act as senior escalation points for critical issues during installation, FAT and SAT, qualification, and post-handover support; make risk-based decisions with Engineering, QA, and IT
* Accountable for deliverable compliance with cGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and site data integrity requirements; define the quality gates managers apply before QA review
* Lead all aspects of change control, deviation, and CAPA performance; set expectations for investigation quality and closure timeliness; own the data integrity gap assessment and remediation roadmap, reporting progress to QC and QA leadership
* Serve as senior spokesperson in regulatory inspections and internal audits; prepare managers and SMEs to defend qualification and implementation records
* Set standard templates, work instructions, and delivery methods across all project types, and institutionalize lessons learned into standards, planning assumptions, and vendor strategy
* Partner with QC and site leadership on the multi-year technology roadmap, assessing automation, sample management, and digital integration against projected demand
* Define the function’s performance metrics (on-time breakthrough delivery, right-first-time qualification, post-handover issue rate) and use trends to drive resource, process, and make investment decisions

**This role requires:**

* BS/BA in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering or a related field and 8+ years of experience
* Previous people leadership/ supervisory experience
* Led, or held a core role on, a build, relocation, major fit-out, or significant technology implementation from requirements through handover
* Experience supporting GMP inspections or internal audits, including presenting and defending records

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

$128,800.00 - $210,200.00

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Location:** Alhambra, CA (Onsite)

 

**Our Team**

SPP is a vertically integrated photonics business focused on the design, fabrication, and delivery of Indium Phosphide (InP) semiconductor laser and gain chips. SPP operates two wafer fabrication facilities in Southern California supporting advanced photonic devices and customer die demand.

 

**Job Summary**

The Sr. Manager, Fab Quality Engineering serves as the senior quality leader within SPP Operations and is responsible for building and leading the manufacturing quality organization across both fabrication facilities. The role establishes quality systems, inspection practices, quality metrics, and quality culture while partnering closely with Operations, Engineering, and the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering to support business growth and manufacturing excellence.

This position provides leadership for manufacturing quality strategy, execution, and organizational development across both fabrication facilities and is expected to maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor. The role supports Epitaxial Growth, Wafer Fabrication, Bar Processing, Chip Processing, and Test Operations, and works closely with Epitaxy, Process, Product, and Equipment Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Test Operations, and Reliability & Failure Analysis.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and lead the SPP Fab Quality organization across both fabrication facilities
* Recruit, develop, and manage quality inspectors while building future technician and quality engineering capabilities
* Establish quality procedures, metrics, escalation processes, reporting systems, and a culture of quality ownership and continuous improvement.
* Establish incoming inspection processes, acceptance criteria, and material-control procedures for critical materials including III-V substrates, epitaxial source materials, specialty gases, precious metals, process chemicals, and optical and test consumables
* Verify material certifications; establish supplier qualification, monitoring, corrective-action, and containment processes
* Ensure traceability and disposition tracking.
* Develop and implement in-process quality control systems, containment and escalation processes for quality excursions, and process controls across manufacturing operations
* Monitor process performance and quality trends
* Drive reduction of defects, scrap, rework, and quality escapes; and ensure consistent quality practices across both fabs.
* Implement and maintain manufacturing quality systems, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), CAPA, Non-Conforming Material Report (NCMR) processes, FMEA, and process control plans
* Provide independent quality review and approval of Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), process changes, and manufacturing transfers
* Establish and maintain ESD control programs and quality documentation and records.
* Lead investigations of manufacturing quality excursions and process escapes in partnership with Process Engineering and Product Engineering
* Monitor process capability (Cp/Cpk)
* Provide quality leadership for measurement-system capability and MSA activities
* Support tool and process qualification and requalification
* Use quality data to improve process stability, defect reduction, and yield.
* Maintain audit readiness across both fabrication facilities
* Support internal, customer, and ISO audits
* Support contamination-control initiatives and cleanroom environmental monitoring
* Ensure quality documentation meets compliance requirements
* Partner with the Sr. Manager, Photonics Quality Engineering on corporate quality initiatives and enterprise quality alignment.
Other relevant tasks, as assigned. 

 
 

**Minimum Qualifications (Education & Experience)**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline
* Experience: 7+ years of manufacturing quality experience within wafer fabrication, photonics, compound semiconductor, or related advanced manufacturing environments
* Leadership: 3+ years of people leadership experience
* Strong knowledge of SPC, CAPA, NCMR, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and manufacturing quality systems
* Experience leading root-cause investigations and corrective-action programs
* Experience supporting semiconductor wafer fabrication or advanced manufacturing operations
* Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills
Experience working effectively across Operations and Engineering functions 

 

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in wafer-fab quality within silicon semiconductor, compound semiconductor, photonics, III-V semiconductor, optoelectronics, or optical communications manufacturing environments
* Experience supporting epitaxial growth operations
* Experience building or scaling manufacturing quality organizations within multi-site manufacturing environments
* Experience with supplier-quality programs and semiconductor MES systems
* Comfortable operating in evolving, high-mix manufacturing environments with limited historical data
Desire to learn InP epitaxial growth, wafer fabrication, and photonics manufacturing technologies 

 

The intent of this job description is to describe the major duties and responsibilities performed by incumbents of this job. Incumbents may be required to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically included in this description.

 

All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

We are proud to be an EEO employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace.

 

A reasonable estimate of the pay range for this position is $130,000 - $180,000. There are several factors taken into consideration in determining base salary, including but not limited to: job-related qualifications, skills, education and experience, as well as job location and the value of other elements of an employee’s total compensation package.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Technology Operations Engineering
new_roles.description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong **Senior Manager – Technology Operations Engineering** to lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Production Support, and operational excellence for enterprise Contact Center Transformation platforms.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the **end-to-end availability, reliability, performance, scalability, and operational stability** of mission-critical voice platforms, contact center applications, cloud-native services, intelligent voice bots, and AI-powered customer engagement solutions.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SRE practices, enterprise application support, Five9, Genesys, telephony technologies, full-stack observability, distributed tracing, and incident management** . The role also requires knowledge of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

The Senior Manager will lead engineering teams responsible for 24x7 production support, proactive monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, change management, automation, and continuous reliability improvements across complex, distributed contact center ecosystems.

 

* **Education & Professional Experience:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with **10+ years of experience** in Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Application Production Support, or Cloud Engineering, including **5+ years in technical leadership or engineering management roles** .

* **Site Reliability Engineering & Application Support:** Extensive hands-on experience in **SRE, enterprise application production support, distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, application performance troubleshooting, service reliability, and 24x7 production operations** , including on-call support and critical incident resolution.

* **Google Cloud Platform (Mandatory):** Strong hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** and cloud-native technologies, including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Pub/Sub, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, API Gateway, cloud networking, load balancing, and containerized application environments.

* **Contact Center & Telephony Expertise:** Proven experience supporting **Five9, Genesys, or similar enterprise contact center platforms** , with a strong understanding of telephony architecture, SIP, RTP, IVR, ACD, CTI, call routing, intelligent voice bots, and contact center integrations. Experience with SpeechMiner or comparable speech analytics platforms is highly desirable.

* **Full-Stack Observability & Distributed Tracing:** Strong experience with **Grafana, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, centralized logging, application performance monitoring, and cloud observability tools** , including the ability to implement end-to-end monitoring and troubleshoot complex distributed application issues.

* **AI, Agentic AI & MCP Technologies:** Experience or strong working knowledge of **conversational AI, intelligent voice bots, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers** , including AI workflow observability, execution tracing, integration troubleshooting, and operational reliability.

* **Incident, Problem & Change Management:** Demonstrated expertise in **ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management** , including major incident leadership, root cause analysis, production change coordination, escalation management, on-call operations, and continuous service improvement.

* **Database & Application Integration Technologies:** Hands-on experience supporting **NoSQL databases, Google Cloud Firestore, Oracle Database, APIs, middleware, and distributed application architectures** , with strong troubleshooting capabilities across database performance, connectivity, transaction processing, and enterprise integrations.

* **Networking, Infrastructure & Automation:** Strong understanding of **TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, SIP/RTP, firewalls, load balancers, traffic routing, cloud networking, Kubernetes, and containerized environments** , along with experience in automation, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as Python, Bash, or Terraform.

* **Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence:** Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage complex production environments, collaborate across technology organizations, and drive **SRE maturity, operational automation, observability improvements, incident reduction, service reliability, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous engineering excellence** , supported by strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

new_roles.title: VP Operations
new_roles.description:
We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels heard and respected, and extending our culture of care so that every individual can reach their full potential. We want you to have a sense of belonging and feel valued for your contributions and the perspectives you bring.

**Summary:**
 
The VP, Operations is the senior manager overseeing all day-to-day project management activities of the Operations business unit. The VP, Operations will oversee all projects and is responsible for the overall administrative and technical direction of site operations as well as planning, coordinating, and directing the entire construction effort to ensure each project is constructed in accordance with design, budget, and schedule.

This role will be hybrid requiring a minimum of 3 days in office.

**Requirements:**

Operational Results:

* Leadership Accountabilities: Identifies, deploys, and manages high-performing teams needed to accomplish business objectives. Provides a positive and engaging work environment by:
* + Recruits and hires outstanding talent.
 + Aligns individual and team objectives to department and company objectives.
 + Manages and supports employee development and growth.
 + Provides regular and direct feedback on performance and goal progress.
* Advanced planning for projects.
* Detailed scope, schedule, and budget management and controls for each project.
* Customer and subcontractor contract negotiation and management.
* Hires, manages, and measures resources including labor, equipment, and subcontractors.
* Directs, measures, and reports progress toward project goals.
* Manages and mentors project directors and project managers.
* Maximizes resource efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensures Site safety and security.
* Ensures proper close out of projects.
* Implements project management system; trains PMs and ensures system is updated regularly.
* Implements communication system to update Management regularly on the status of projects.
* Communicates with customers project status and diplomatically handles customer concerns.
* Maintains all necessary training and certifications for construction staff.
* Ensures Compliance & Policy – OSHA, State and Federal standards, and drug testing.
* 100% Customer satisfaction.

Financial Accountability:

* Participates in estimate reviews and approves prior to submittal to the client.
* Regular review of project financial performance.
* Maintains strong financial transparency in all relationships with Management.
* Identifies opportunities for improvements in operations that will translate to bottom line results.
* Anticipates and minimizes cost overruns.
* Ensures client change orders are introduced and executed timely.
* Meets or beats project budgets.
* Increases gross profit margins on construction projects.

Business Development Support:

* Supports business development in the proposal process to ensure a clean transition to project execution at the time of award from the customer.
* Builds and maintains relationships with subcontractors and vendors.
* Participates in proposal interviews and meetings, as required.
* Follows safety and security procedures and determines appropriate action.
* Reports potentially unsafe conditions and uses materials and equipment properly.
* Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
* Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct, and Company Policies & Procedures.

**Safety:**

* Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
* Leads by example to show that safety is the most important function, ensuring that all employees follow safe practices while working.
* Accountable to continually reinforce safe behaviors and correct “at risk” behaviors.
* Adheres to and ensures all site team members understands standard operating procedures.
* Leads and supports the site team in technical, quality and safety, utilizing system in place.
* Follows safety and security procedures and determines appropriate action.
* Reports potentially unsafe conditions and uses materials and equipment properly.
* Ensures Compliance & Policy – OSHA, State and Federal standards, drug testing.

**Leadership:**

* Fosters and demonstrates a workplace inclusive of creating opportunity, serving others, building trust, innovation, and exceeding expectations.
* Manages multiple direct reports.
* Participates in hiring and selection process to fill positions on the team.
* Communicates regularly with direct reports on goals, accomplishments, and information on policies.
* Demonstrates leadership and expertise in eyes of client group.
* Employee Development:
* + Provides tasks and assignments that challenge and stretch employees’ responsibilities.
 + Conducts regular discussions with employee(s) on personal development. Comfortable with empowering others.
 + Conducts timely, effective performance reviews in accordance with RES guidelines.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or construction or equivalent relevant experience required.
* 10 or more years of industry-related experience in operationally complex organizations required.
* 10 or more years of leadership experience managing solar construction projects and teams to include both direct team leadership development and large operations team leadership required.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally 51-75%.
* Must possess a valid driver’s license.
* Contract negotiation and change order management.
* Knowledge of project execution, cost reporting, forecasting, production tracking, scheduling, and overall construction operations.
* Communication
* + Internally with executive managers, Project Managers, Estimators, Commercial Management, Engineering, Finance, Fleet and Equipment, Legal, HSQE, Operations, Human Resources, and cross-functional departmental teams.
 + Externally with clients, potential clients, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Track record of building, leading, and managing construction teams.
* Track record of directing, measuring, and reporting progress toward project goals.
* Understanding of project accounting and controls.
* Risk assessment policies and procedures.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite and Procore.
* Functional competencies include accountability, building strategic partnerships, business acumen, ethics & integrity, and managing vision & purpose.

Job Level: This position is aligned to Grade 10 within our global job architecture framework. The grade reflects the role's responsibilities, decision-making authority, and organizational impact and supports consistency in career growth and compensation practices across the company.

RES offers benefits that are effective first day of employment. These benefits include the following:

* Medical, Dental and Vision
* Health Savings Account with employer contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* 4x pay Basic Life and Voluntary Life
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Accident, Hospital, and Critical Illness
* 401 (k) plan with 6% company match
* 4 weeks Paid Time Off (PTO) and 10 Paid Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement and Green Car Reimbursement
* Volunteer and Charity Matching
* Paid Parental Leave and Paid Sabbatical Leave
* Employee Referral Bonus
* Employee Discounts and Wellness programs
* Wellness Reimbursement

**Physical requirements and environment:**

The work environment and physical demands characteristics are representative of those the employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Rarely: Climbing, crouching, kneeling, pulling/pushing/lifting between 5-15lbs., and stooping are required.

Occasionally: Carrying 5-15lbs., gripping, handling, pinching, and walking are required.

Frequently: Standing is required.

Constantly: Reading, grasping, hearing, reaching, vision, repetitive motion, and sitting is required.

Rarely exposed to extreme cold, heat, and humidity, and wet climates, in the working environment.

Occasionally exposed to noise and hazards in the work environment.

We maintain a drug-free workplace. Candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment background investigation and drug test as a condition of employment.

RES is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
