**Company****:**
================

AHI agilon health, inc.

**Job Posting Location****:**
=============================

Remote - USA

**Job Title****:**
==================

Regional Director, Operations

**Job Description****:**
========================

***Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.***

The Regional Director of Operations has end-to-end operational accountability for planning, execution, and continuous improvement of market-level Risk Adjustment (BOI), Quality (HEDIS) and Cost of Care operation programs across multiple markets. This role owns operational processes, staffing, budgets, vendor relationships, data and technology enablement, and performance outcomes. The Director partners with platform BOI/Quality, Market Medical Directors, IT/Engineering, Data & Analytics, Finance and RBEs/providers to deliver compliant, scalable, and measurable operational performance.

*This role requires travel 4–10 days per month to visit partner groups*

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Operational Leadership & Execution – 45%**

* Lead and operationalize BOI, Quality and Cost of Care programs across 3+ markets; develop and enforce SOPs, SLAs and RACI for all program activities.
* Collaborate with Central Operations to manager operation, performance and outcomes related to pre-visit record review, post-visit coding review, chart collection, query workflows and provider engagement processes.
* In close partnership with the Market Leader and market operations team, oversee market operations, monitor performance, and implement corrective action and performance improvement plans.
* Define operational KPIs, run root cause analysis, lead process improvement efforts and institutionalize best practices across markets.
* Serve as the escalation point for market operational issues and lead cross-functional readiness for new initiatives.
* Provide oversight of operating budgets for BOI/Quality (labor, contractors, vendor spend); forecast resource needs and identify cost-to-serve improvements.

**Data & Technology Ownership – 35%**

* Partner with Data & Analytics and IT/Engineering to define technical requirements, data pipelines, EMR/claims integrations, and dashboards to support risk capture and quality improvement.
* In partnership with Tech, innovate on and participate in testing of solutions that drive automation and technology enablement to reduce manual effort and increase operational scale.

**People & Capacity – 20%**

* In collaboration with and informed by input from the Regional President, lead capacity planning, staffing models, recruitment, training and performance management for market BOI/Quality operations.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Minimum Experience:**

* 5+ years healthcare operations experience; 3+ years leading multi-market risk adjustment or quality programs

**Education/Licensure:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
* Six Sigma/Lean certification preferred

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Solid knowledge of HEDIS, risk adjustment coding and healthcare data (claims/EMR)
* Demonstrated management of operational teams and vendor partners
* Analytics fluency (dashboards/KPI’s and either direct SQL or close collaboration with analytics teams)
* Proven program and project management skills and process improvement experience
* *Language Skills:* Strong communication skills both written and verbal to work with multiple internal and external clients in a fast-paced environment
* *Mathematical Skills:* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
* *Reasoning Ability:* Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
* *Computer Skills:* Ability to create and maintain documents using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)

**Essential Physical Functions:**

These are requirements normally expected to perform regular job duties. Incumbent must be able to successfully perform all the functions of the job with or without accommodation.

new_roles.title: Director, Enterprise Business Transformation & Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job Title:** Director, Enterprise Business Transformation & Operational Excellence

**Location:** Westfield, IN

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

 
 

We are seeking a hands-on transformation leader to drive enterprise-wide strategy, operating-model improvements, and value creation across a complex, multi-site industrial business. This role is a core member of the organizational leadership team, with a mandate to personally lead, structure, analyze, and execute transformation initiatives—working directly with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to turn strategy into measurable results.

 
 

This person will operate as a strategic problem solver and execution partner, identifying opportunities, building business cases, redesigning processes, and driving initiatives through implementation and value realization. For the right candidate, this role offers a clear path to building and leading a dedicated transformation team as the capability matures within the organization.

 
 

**OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Personally lead enterprise transformation and operating-model improvement initiatives from problem definition and strategy through execution and measurable value realization.
* Analyze business performance, identify operational and financial improvement opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Drive operational excellence initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous-improvement methodologies to improve cost, quality, safety, delivery, and profitability.
* Lead and support M&A activities, including due diligence, post-merger integration, carve-outs, and synergy/value-capture initiatives.
* Build and maintain transformation roadmaps, business cases, financial models, project plans, KPIs, and governance mechanisms.
* Work directly with commercial, finance, and operations leaders to improve P&L performance, profitable growth, and value creation.
* Identify opportunities to modernize core systems and processes, including ERP/SAP, and evaluate AI-enabled and digital solutions based on measurable business impact.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, resolve complex business problems, and personally drive critical initiatives to completion.
* Collaborate with colleagues in our Strategy and Transformation office in Europe, contributing to globally coordinated initiatives and sharing best practices across geographies.
* Present findings, recommendations, progress, and results to executive leadership and other key stakeholders
 

 

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* 10+ years of experience in transformation, strategy, operations, management consulting, or operational excellence, ideally within industrial, manufacturing, automation, or supply-chain environments.
* Demonstrated experience personally driving complex transformation initiatives from analysis through implementation, rather than primarily overseeing teams or programs.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable results, including revenue growth, margin expansion, cost reduction, productivity improvements, and other value-creation initiatives.
* Deep expertise in operational excellence, Lean / Six Sigma, and structured problem solving; Black Belt preferred.
* Experience with M&A integration, operating-model design, process optimization, and value-capture initiatives.
* Strong financial acumen, including P&L, EBIT, business cases, ROI, planning, and financial modeling.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and execution skills with the ability to move from high-level strategy into detailed implementation.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* MBA from a leading program and/or an engineering background strongly preferred.
* Experience with AI-enabled / digital transformation and agentic GTM.
* Warehouse/manufacturing automation domain knowledge, including WES/MES, aftermarket service, or commercial project controlling.
* ERP/SAP implementation or optimization experience.
* Global / multi-continent experience, particularly US and APAC.
* Experience working in a PE-backed or highly performance-driven industrial environment.

**PROFESSIONAL QUALITIES**

* Hands-on and action-oriented, with a willingness to personally dive into analysis, problem-solving, and execution.
* Highly analytical and intellectually curious, with the ability to simplify complex business challenges and identify practical solutions.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build credibility across all levels of the organization.
* Results-driven and accountable, with a strong focus on measurable business impact and value creation.
* Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and lead change without relying on direct authority.
 

 

**WORK CONDITIONS**

* Regular in-office collaboration with executive and cross-functional teams.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support business initiatives, operating locations, and global collaboration.
* Fast-paced, highly visible role requiring the ability to manage multiple strategic priorities and adapt as business needs evolve.
* Regular interaction with senior leadership and teams across functions, business units, and geographies.
 

 

**Why work for Storage Solutions – A Jungheinrich Company?**

At Storage Solutions, our greatest asset is our people. We have built a team of passionate intralogistics experts who collaborate and partner with distribution and fulfillment operations across North America and worldwide. We believe in providing tailored solutions for every square foot of an operation, and behind these solutions is a carefully selected team that shares our vision, culture, and core values.

We are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where every team member can thrive. When you join us, you become part of a family that values your growth, well-being, and contributions. Together, we innovate, solve challenges, and celebrate successes.

 
 

**Additional Benefits**

* Competitive Salary and Bonus Structure
* Generous Paid Time Off
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* 401K with Company Match
* Company HSA Contribution

new_roles.title: Director, AG Strategy & Operations
new_roles.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the role & team**
-------------------------

We are building a central BU Authenticity Guarantee (AG) Centre of Excellence within eBay’s GFC organisation to strengthen the AG proposition and scale shared capabilities.

 
 

As **Director, AG Strategy & Operations**, you will report to the **GM, Portfolio Strategy & Operations — Global Focus Categories & Live**. You will examine and refine the cross-category strategy, lead and develop a high-performing team, and translate priorities into measurable business outcomes. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strategic judgment, operational understanding, and accountability for delivery—not just recommendations.

 
 

You will work closely alongside category divisions, which own category initiatives and commercial outcomes, and AuthOps, which manages authentication operations.

 
 

**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------

* **AG Strategy & Proposition:** Review and evolve the cross-category AG strategy, customer promise, and shared roadmap. Establish common experience standards and commercial guardrails, balancing consistency with category-specific needs.
* **Business Cases & Investment Prioritisation:** Build clear processes to develop, evaluate, and prioritise cases.Bring together category, finance, product, and AuthOps input to assess customer value, economics, operational feasibility, and expected returns.
* **Hands-On Execution:** Own cross-category initiatives from planning through delivery, with clear achievements and accountability. Spend time in AG centres to understand workflows, customer problems, and operational constraints, translating these insights into practical improvements with category teams and AuthOps.
* **Performance & Scalable Processes:** Establish critical metrics, operating reviews, and reusable launch and expansion playbooks.Track results against arguments, address gaps, and scale successful approaches across categories and markets.
* **People & Cross-Functional Leadership:** Lead and develop the team, aligning partners across category leadership, product, engineering, marketing, AuthOps, and other functions. Resolve dependencies, drive decisions, and communicate clear recommendations and progress to senior leadership.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* **Strategic & commercial judgment:** Significant experience in strategy, business operations, or general management, with strong business-case development, financial analysis, and investment prioritisation skills.
* **Execution & ownership:** A proven record of turning strategy into measurable results. A hands-on approach to understanding operations, solving problems, and delivering improvements, including willingness to travel to AG centres.
* **People & collaborator leadership:** Demonstrated success developing teams and influencing senior collaborators across business, product, and operations, with clear accountability for outcomes.
* **Analytical & communication skills:** Ability to translate data and customer insights into actionable recommendations and executive-ready communications. Experience in marketplaces, eCommerce, or customer trust is preferred; direct authentication experience is a plus.

**Why join us**
---------------

Help shape AG across eBay, building a team that connects customer trust with commercial growth and delivers improvements across categories and markets.

At eBay, our customers are our compass. We foster a culture where authenticity thrives, bold ideas are encouraged, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work.

**Additional Details**

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$195,200 - $260,600

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guideline.

Apply Now

new_roles.title: Sr. Director, Operations Excellence
new_roles.description:
**About Prime Data Centers**

Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. A private firm owned by a group controlling $6 billion in assets, with a 15-year tenure in technology and real estate development, Prime provides customers with ownership options and dynamic leasing models, defining a true corporate partnership.

**About the role**

The Sr. Director, Operations Excellence reports to the VP, Business Operations and leads the company's continuous improvement and process standardization strategy. This role owns the governance framework underpinning the PMO function and leads the Sr. Manager, PMO, ensuring a consistent approach to initiative delivery across the business.

The Sr. Director, Operations Excellence partners cross-functionally with other business units to extend improvement methodologies into construction workflows, and serves as a key advisor to the VP, Business Operations on operational performance and initiative prioritization.

**What you'll do**

**Operational Strategy & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and lead the enterprise continuous improvement strategy, driving process standardization and efficiency across Business Operations
* Establish methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, or similar) for identifying and executing improvement initiatives
* Own the governance framework underpinning the PMO function

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop the PMO function, including portfolio governance, playbooks, training, and change management execution
* Partner with other internal functions to extend improvement methodologies into system and process workflows

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with IT, Data, Business Transformation and other functional leaders to align improvement priorities with business goals
* Serve as a key advisor to the VP, Business Operations on operational performance and initiative prioritization

**Performance Management**

* Define and track KPIs measuring the effectiveness of improvement initiatives across the organization
* Present initiative outcomes and operational performance updates to senior leadership

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree required
* 10+ years of experience in operations, process improvement, or program management, including people leadership experience
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a PMO or governance function
* Strong executive presence and communication skills
* Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional and matrixed teams

**Preferred**

* MBA or other advanced degree
* Lean/Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt)
* Experience in construction, real estate, or infrastructure industries

**Benefits**

* Comp - $230,700 - $304,700 along with an annual performance bonus
* 401k up to a 4% employer match that is fully vested upon enrollment

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence, is a hands-on practitioner who supports ESCO sites in deploying the **ESCO Operating System (EOS)**. The person in this role travels to sites to facilitate Kaizen events, take part in key EOS activities, and coach site leaders and teams to strengthen EOS adoption, practice, and results.

Site Presidents and site EOS Managers own and lead EOS deployment at their sites. This role supports them as an experienced practitioner and member of a small central EOS team. The EOS Program Lead owns program strategy and the development of EOS elements, and a peer role owns data, tools, KPIs, and monthly business reviews. This role helps sites put EOS standards into practice on the floor and brings field learning back to improve those standards.

This is a director-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. It works through influence with site leaders and teams. The initial focus is the Aerospace & Defense group, with expansion to other ESCO divisions as EOS deployment grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Site Deployment Support***

* Support site Presidents and EOS Managers in executing their annual EOS deployment plans toward EOS maturity certifications.
* Participate in key EOS activities during site visits, such as MDI, Kaizen events, and Gemba Walks, and provide sites with direct feedback to enhance adoption and practice.
* Help sites put EOS elements into practice, including MDI, Gemba Walks, KPI management, action management, P&R, structured problem solving, and leader standard work.
* Provide sites with continued support to improve EOS adoption, sustainment, and results.

***Kaizen and Improvement Events***

* Plan and facilitate Kaizen events with site teams: scoping and chartering with site leadership, pre-event data collection, team training, current state analysis, implementation on the floor, report-out, and 30/60/90-day follow-up.
* Help sites build and manage their CI pipeline so events are selected based on business priorities, KPI gaps, and financial impact.
* Develop site Kaizen leaders and facilitators so sites can run events on their own and meet their annual Kaizen plan.
* Document event results and savings, and partner with site finance to validate benefits.

***Coaching and Capability Building***

* Deliver EOS training on site, from leadership sessions to hands-on floor training for supervisors and team members.
* Coach site leaders, supervisors, and EOS Managers on daily management, visual management, standard work, and problem solving.
* Support site EOS Managers in developing EOS champions and practitioners at their sites.

***Assessment, Tracking, and Feedback***

* Support EOS maturity assessments and certification readiness reviews, including site tours, interviews, and evidence review.
* Monitor deployment progress, action closure, and sustainment at supported sites, and report status to the EOS Program Lead.
* Help site leaders remove barriers, and raise issues to the EOS Program Lead when deployment is at risk.
* Bring field feedback into the EOS program: what works, what does not, and where process guides, tools, and training need to change.
* Share good practices across sites and connect site teams with each other.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Supply Chain, or related field required.
* 8+ years of experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement, Lean, or manufacturing operations, including at least 5 years in a hands-on deployment or practitioner role.
* Has personally facilitated 10 - 20 or more Kaizen events with documented results.
* Hands-on experience practicing and coaching tiered daily management (MDI or similar), Gemba Walks, visual management, standard work, and structured problem solving (A3, PDCA, root cause analysis).
* Experience in a company with a structured operating or business system strongly preferred. Must be a U.S. Person and able to provide appropriate documentation
* Experience supporting deployment across multiple sites preferred.
* Plant or operations leadership experience preferred. Credibility with site leaders and on the floor is essential.
* Aerospace, defense, industrial, or complex high-mix manufacturing experience preferred.
* Lean, Kaizen, or Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Must be a U.S. Person with a valid US passport with the ability to travel internationally.

**Required Capabilities**

* Practitioner first: comfortable on the shop floor and leading teams through hands-on change.
* Strong event facilitation, with the ability to lead mixed teams from operators to executives.
* Direct, constructive coaching of leaders at all levels, including senior leaders.
* Business acumen: connects improvement work to KPIs, EBIT, and customer commitments.
* Ability to adapt to sites at different maturity levels without lowering the standard.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Self-directed and organized; manages a multi-site schedule with limited supervision.
* High accountability for follow-through and sustainment.

**Travel**

Expected travel of approximately **60% to 80%**, primarily domestic, with some international travel to sites in Mexico and the UK. A typical site visit runs 3 to 5 days, such as a Kaizen event week or a site support visit covering MDI, Gemba Walks, and other EOS activities. Candidates should be based near a major airport.

**Compensation Information** 
Base Salary Range: $190,000 - $220,000 USD (Annually)

**Actual base salary offered to the hired applicant will be determined based on their work location, level, qualifications, job related skills, as well as relevant education or training experience.**

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Brand:**

Bagel Brands

**Bagel Brands is the parent company for your favorite breakfast brands, Einstein Bros. Bagels, Bruegger's Bagels, Noah's NY Bagels, and Manhattan Bagel. We believe in the bagel and how it has the unique ability to bring people together. Our team has a standard set of values and behaviors that allow us to spread a little more joy and happiness in the world. They let us laugh, smile, and enjoy each other’s company a little more. These are the behaviors that guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we treat our guests. We believe that there is no better way to make someone’s day than with a warm, fresh-baked bagel and a heart-felt good morning.**

**POSITION MISSION**

The Director, Operations Excellence leads the strategy, team, and discipline that make it easier for our bakery teams to obsess over our guests and deliver great results every day. This role owns the enterprise operations engineering agenda for Bagel Brands — evaluating how work gets done, designing better ways of working, and building the team needed to test, scale, and sustain change across Field Operations and Support Center teams.

 

In alignment with Bagel Brands’ Mission, Vision, and Values, this role builds an organization that helps teams Take Ownership of better ways of working, Support Each Other through thoughtful change, and ultimately creates simpler, more consistent operations that allow bakery teams to Obsess Over Our Guests.

 
 

Department: Operations

Salary: $180,000 to $200,000

Annual Bonus: 20%

Long Term Incentive Plan: $30,000

 

**RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

**Strategic Leadership & Vision**

* Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Operations Excellence, aligning priorities with enterprise strategy and Field Operations needs.

* Build and prioritize a portfolio of process engineering and continuous improvement initiatives across the bakery system.

* Represent Operations Excellence in senior leadership and strategic planning forums, translating field findings into enterprise decisions.

 
 

**Operations Excellence & Process Engineering**

* Oversee evaluation of bakery processes, workflows, and systems to simplify work, optimize labor investments, reduce waste, and strengthen performance.

* Guide application of Lean, Six Sigma, process mapping, and root-cause analysis across a portfolio of concurrent initiatives.

* Own the standard for future-state process design, balancing efficiency, guest experience, team member experience, and financial impact.

* Ensure the team produces process maps, standard work, and tools that translate solutions into repeatable bakery practices at scale.

 
 

**Testing, Piloting & Continuous Improvement**

* Set the standard for how the organization designs and governs operational pilots before broader rollout.

* Review pilot results with senior leadership and make scale, refine, or discontinue recommendations.

* Sponsor root-cause analysis on significant recurring challenges, ensuring solutions are sustainable rather than short-term fixes.

 
 

**Labor and Inventory Analytics and Systems Optimization**

* Own labor and inventory system optimization through consistent review of program enhancements, labor/inventory performance opportunities, and cross-functional partnerships with IT, Finance, and program owners.

* Create and maintain regular reporting for Ops teams that highlights opportunities for improvement

 
 

**Project & Change Management**

* Own the portfolio of cross-functional operational excellence initiatives from problem identification through sustainment.

* Set the organization’s approach to structured change management and ensure it is applied consistently.

* Maintain enterprise-level visibility to portfolio progress, risks, and business impact.

 
 

**Team & Field Leadership**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of Operations Excellence managers and professionals.

* Coach the team on problem solving, project management, and change leadership, building bench strength for future roles.

* Maintain regular presence in bakeries, partnering with Field Operations leaders to test and validate solutions.

* Identify successful practices within the bakery system and lead efforts to standardize and scale them.

 
 

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Measurement**

* Partner with Training, Technology, Marketing, Culinary/R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, and Development to evaluate the impact of enterprise initiatives.

* Represent the Operations perspective in cross-functional and executive-level project governance.

* Own the measurement framework used to demonstrate whether operational improvements are delivering results.

* Deliver clear, data-driven recommendations and portfolio updates to senior Operations leadership.

 

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES (DIRECTOR / SENIOR DIRECTOR)**

* *Effective Communication:* Articulates vision and manages difficult conversations cross-functionally; communicates complex initiatives and navigates executive discussions.
* *Accountability & Ownership:* Owns budget and strategy and drives a culture of accountability; manages multi-team performance and champions data-driven decisions.
* *Adaptability & Perseverance:* Leads the department through major change and anticipates trends; drives change across functions and builds resilient teams.
* *Empowerment:* Creates space for innovation and mentors emerging leaders; designs structures for decentralized decision-making.
* *Curiosity:* Probes beyond surface issues and fosters a learning environment; benchmarks against top organizations and sponsors new ideas.
* *Self-Awareness:* Understands own leadership brand and exhibits humility; holds deep clarity on values and stays resilient under pressure.

 

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

**Required**

* 10+ years of experience in restaurant operations, operations excellence, continuous improvement, or a related discipline.

* 3+ years of experience directly leading and developing a team.

* Track record of leading enterprise-scale, cross-functional projects with measurable business impact.

* Strong strategic, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills.

* Strong portfolio and project management skills, with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and budgets.

* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change at the senior leadership level without direct authority.

* Excellent executive presentation skills and ability to travel regularly to bakery locations.

 
 

**Preferred**

* Direct restaurant or multi-unit operations leadership experience.

* Advanced experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, or comparable methodologies.

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, Prosci Change Management, or comparable certification.

* Experience within QSR, fast casual, retail, or another high-volume, multi-unit consumer environment.

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree (MBA or related) preferred, or equivalent experience.

 

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

This position requires regular travel to bakery locations across multiple regions, including standing, walking, and observing operations on-site, as well as the ability to sit, use a computer, and participate in meetings for extended periods. These requirements may be met with or without reasonable accommodation.

 

**The duties of this position may change from time to time. The Company reserves the right to add or delete duties and responsibilities at the discretion of the Company or its managers. This job description is intended to describe the general level of work being performed. It is not intended to be all-inclusive.**

new_roles.title: Director of Protective Operations and Logistics
new_roles.description:
**Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.**

### **Job Description:**

Director, Executive Protection, Protective Operations and Logistics

The Role:

As the Director of Protective Operations and Logistics within the Executive Protection team, you will be responsible for executive protection program management and logistical planning, including staffing, scheduling*,* protective transportation operations, support request vetting and assessment, training administration, and oversight of the TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program. Reporting to the Head of Executive Protection, you will provide operational leadership, program oversight, and subject matter expertise on executive protection and protective operations matters. You willbe responsible for ensuring the effective execution of day-to-day protective operations while supporting the continued enhancement of the firm's executive protection capabilities. The position requires close collaboration with Global Security Operations, the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Travel Security, and key internal and external partners to implement and support Fidelity's executive protection strategy. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational, leadership, and relationship-management skills, as well as the ability to balance competing priorities while delivering consistent, discreet, and service-oriented experience for Fidelity's senior leadership.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

* 7-10 years of experience protecting C-suite executives, board members, and/or government officials in complex, dynamic, and globally distributed operating environments within corporate, government, military, or law enforcement settings.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple workstreams
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, security professionals, and external stakeholders
* Extensive knowledge of executive protection operations, including protective advances, travel security, transportation security, venue assessment, route planning and protective operations logistics.
* Expertise in assessing, prioritizing, and coordinating executive support requests while balancing risk, resource requirements, and business priorities.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required and operate effectively in dynamic, rapidly changing, and high-pressure environments.
* Strong understanding of TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program requirements, administration, compliance, certifications, and operational integration; the ability to obtain and maintain ASO certification is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage executive protection staffing models, personnel scheduling, resource allocation, and operational readiness across multiple locations and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, develop, and build high-performing teams while fostering a culture of professionalism, accountability, discretion, and service excellence.
* Experience coordinating and supporting executive travel, special events, corporate meetings, and other high-visibility engagements requiring detailed planning and collaboration.
* Experience managing executive transportation programs, including vehicle operations, driver standards, fleet utilization, and transportation security protocols.
* Experience developing and managing executive protection training programs, operational exercises, performance standards, readiness assessments, and professional development initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree is preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Relevant professional certifications such as CTM, CPP, PSP, ASIS Executive Protection Professional (EPP), TSA ASO, or other intelligence, investigation, or executive protection credentials are a plus.
* undefined

The Purpose of Your Role

 

* Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of executive protection programs that ensure the safety, privacy, and operational effectiveness of Fidelity's executive leadership.
* Manage the day-to-day administration and logistical support of executive protection operations, including staffing, scheduling, executive travel, protective transportation, training, and resource allocation.
* Provide operational leadership and oversight for executive protection program management, ensuring consistent service delivery, operational readiness, and alignment with organizational priorities.
* Serve as a trusted partner to executive stakeholders by delivering responsive, discreet, and customer-focused protective services in support of business activities and executive requirements.
* Oversee the planning and coordination of executive travel, special events, site visits, and high-profile engagements, ensuring appropriate protective measures and logistical support are in place.
* Manage and enhance the TSA Aircraft Security Officer (ASO) program, executive transportation services, training initiatives, and other core executive protection capabilities.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor to senior executives, providing strategic guidance, risk-based recommendations, and executive-level briefings on protective operations, emerging threats, and security-related matters.

The Team

The Executive Protection team is part of the broader Protective Services team, which in turn is part of Fidelity’s Global Security team. The Executive Protection team is a highly valued team dedicated to the protection of the firm’s executive leadership and events.

Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model 
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

The base salary range for this position is $95,000-186,000 USD per year.

Placement in the range will vary based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors.

Base salary is only part of the total compensation package. Depending on the position and eligibility requirements, the offer package may also include bonus or other variable compensation.

We offer a wide range of benefits to meet your evolving needs and help you live your best life at work and at home. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage and emotional well-being support, market-leading retirement, generous paid time off and parental leave, charitable giving employee match program, and educational assistance including student loan repayment, tuition reimbursement, and learning resources to develop your career. Note, the application window closes when the position is filled or unposted.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of Operations - 7 Brew** 
 
**About Southern Brew** 
At 7 Brew, we serve more than just coffee - we're brewing connection, culture, and community at high speed. Every stand is built on energy, authenticity, and exceptional service. 
Southern Brew operates more than 80 stands and is rapidly expanding its 7 Brew portfolio, with plans to become one of the largest 7 Brew franchisees in the country over the next five years. 
 
We're looking for a **Director of Operations** to help lead that growth. 
 
**The Role** 
As Director of Operations, you'll lead and develop Regional Managers while driving operational excellence, financial performance, talent development, and successful new stand openings across your market. 
You'll be responsible for turning company goals into results while building strong leaders and ensuring every stand delivers the culture and experience 7 Brew is known for. 
 
**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop Regional Managers and their teams
* Drive sales, profitability, labor, inventory, retention, and guest satisfaction results
* Use P&Ls and key performance metrics to identify opportunities and improve performance
* Conduct regular market and stand visits to coach leaders and ensure operational excellence
* Build a strong pipeline of Regional Managers, Stand Managers, and future leaders
* Ensure consistent execution of 7 Brew brand standards, systems, safety, and operational expectations
* Partner with our support teams to strengthen staffing and retention
* Lead operational readiness and execution for successful new stand openings
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning as the business grows
* Champion a high-energy culture built around people, accountability, recognition, and results

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant multi-unit leadership experience in QSR, fast casual, retail, hospitality, or a similar high-volume environment
* Experience leading multi-unit leaders such as Regional or District Managers strongly preferred
* Proven success driving sales, profitability, operational performance, and team development
* Strong P&L and financial management skills
* Proven ability to develop and retain high-performing leaders
* New store opening or high-growth experience preferred
* Strong communication, coaching, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing organization
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout assigned markets

 
If you're a people-first operator who loves developing leaders, driving results, and building something as it grows, we'd love to hear from you.

Sodexo Seniors is seeking a Director of Facilities Operations to support facilities maintenance operations for multiple accounts in the Northeast. Travel will be at 40% and candidate will need to be based in Harrisburg or Lancaster, PA area.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in facilities management, preferably in a healthcare/senior living or regulated environment. Will ensure safe, efficient & well-maintained facilities, delivering exceptional service to client & residents.

**About the job**

In this senior leadership role, you’ll be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facilities operations, from skilled trades and maintenance programs to staffing, safety, and compliance, across complex, high-impact environments. You’ll lead multidisciplinary teams, ensure optimal building performance, and partner with internal stakeholders to drive strategic improvements and operational excellence.

Accountable for managing people, setting direction and deploying resources; typically is responsible for performance evaluation, pay reviews and hire/fire decisions. Results are primarily achieved through the work of others and typically depend on the manager's ability to influence and negotiate with parts of the organization. Progression within Career Band reflects acquisition of broad technical expertise, business and industry knowledge, and process and people leadership capabilities. Accountable for business, functional or operational areas, processes or programs, which may include dotted-line or matrixed management.

**Pay Range:** $115940 per year - $180070 per year

**Incentive Eligibility:** Eligible to participate in Sodexo's incentive plan and earn variable compensation in addition to base salary

**What’s in it for you**

* Lead large-scale facilities operations where your decisions directly impact safety, efficiency, and business continuity.
* Influence strategy and drive innovation by overseeing key infrastructure systems and service delivery.
* Build and lead high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability, development, and technical excellence.
* Play a pivotal role in construction planning, system upgrades, and long-term asset preservation.
* Gain visibility and collaboration opportunities with senior stakeholders across a broad operational landscape.
* Manage operational budgets and resources while aligning facilities strategy with organizational goals.
* Thrive in a purpose-driven environment that rewards leadership, problem-solving, and operational precision.

**What you’ll bring**

3+ years of facilities, engineering, or maintenance management experience, preferably in healthcare, senior living, or a related industry. Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building systems maintenance.

* Proven experience leading complex facilities operations, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and utility systems.
* Leadership skills with the skillset to manage, mentor, and inspire both frontline teams and management staff.
* Expertise in overseeing construction projects, capital improvements, and long- term infrastructure planning.
* Financial acumen, with experience managing budgets, contracts, and resource allocation.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to drive alignment and operational success across diverse teams.

**Requirements**

* Education Requirement: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Management Experience: 5 years
* Related Experience: 5 years

**What we offer**

Compensation is fair and equitable, partially determined by a candidate's education level or years of relevant experience. Salary offers are based on a candidate's specific criteria, like experience, skills, education, and training. Sodexo offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

* Medical, Dental, Vision Care and Wellness Programs
* 401(k) Plan with Matching Contributions
* Paid Time Off and Company Holidays
* Career Growth Opportunities and Tuition Reimbursement

More extensive information is provided to new employees upon hire.

At Sodexo, our purpose is to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all. We believe in improving the quality of life for those we serve and contributing to the economic, social, and environmental progress in the communities where we operate. Sodexo partners with clients to provide a truly memorable experience for both customers and employees alike. We do this by providing food service, catering, facilities management, and other integrated solutions worldwide.

existing_roles.title: Senior Director, Device Quality
existing_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**General Summary:**

The Senior Director, Device Quality provides strategic Quality leadership and oversight for Vertex device and combination product operations across development, manufacturing, testing, clinical, commercial, and post-market activities.

The role is accountable for **risk-based operational Quality oversight of internal activities and external partners** , including CDMOs, testing laboratories, and critical suppliers. The role ensures compliance with **ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 14971** , and applicable global device and combination product requirements.

The Senior Director serves as the **Management Representative for the Device QMS** , providing leadership for QMS effectiveness, regulatory compliance, management review, inspection readiness, and continual improvement. The role partners with senior Quality and business leaders on **enterprise Quality initiatives** .

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

• Define and execute the **Device Operational QA strategy** aligned with business, portfolio, and product priorities.

• Provide Quality oversight of **CDMOs, suppliers, testing laboratories, and other external partners** , including quality agreements, audits, performance, and risk management.

• Provide Quality oversight of **internal design control, design transfer, manufacturing, testing, and product realization activities** .

• Serve as **Management Representative** for the Device QMS, ensuring QMS effectiveness, management review, compliance, and continual improvement.

• Ensure compliance with **ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 14971** , and applicable global regulatory requirements.

• Provide strategic oversight of **deviations, investigations, CAPA, change control, complaints, supplier quality, audits, and inspection readiness** .

• Establish and monitor **Quality metrics, risks, trends, and performance** , driving timely escalation and resolution of significant issues.

• Provide Quality leadership for **regulatory inspections, notified body audits, product milestones, and launch readiness** .

• Partner with senior leaders on **enterprise-wide Quality initiatives** that improve compliance, operational effectiveness, and business performance.

* Build organizational capability through **talent development, coaching, and strong cross-functional leadership** **.**

  

**Knowledge and Skills:**

• Broad expertise in **Device and Combination Product Quality Assurance, QMS, and operational Quality oversight** .

• Strong knowledge of **ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 14971** , and applicable global regulatory requirements.

• Demonstrated experience with **CDMO/external partner oversight, supplier Quality, testing, audits, and inspection readiness** .

• Strong understanding of **design controls, design transfer, risk management, manufacturing controls, supplier controls, and product realization** .

• Proven experience with **CAPA, investigations, deviations, change control, complaints, and quality risk management** .

• Demonstrated capability to serve as **Management Representative** , including QMS performance, management review, compliance oversight, and risk escalation.

• Strong **strategic thinking, business acumen, risk-based decision-making, and problem-solving** skills.

• Ability to influence senior leaders and drive outcomes in a **complex, matrixed organization** .

• Demonstrated leadership in **cross-functional strategic initiatives** .

• Strong people leadership skills with demonstrated ability to **develop talent, build organizational capability, and foster Quality ownership** .

  

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelors degree in a scientific, allied health, or operations research field
Typically requires 15 years of relevant work experience and 5 years of supervisory/management experience or the equivalent combination of education and experience  

  

#LI-Hybrid

  
  

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:

2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

existing_roles.title: Director, Quality Operations
existing_roles.description:
At Keros, our mission is to deliver significant clinical benefit to a wide range of patients with disorders that are linked to dysfunctional signaling of the transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-ß) family of proteins. With a focus on developing differentiated product candidates that are designed to alter TGF-β signaling, we aim to target the pathways critical for the growth, repair and maintenance of blood cells and a number of tissues, including bone, skeletal muscle, adipose and heart tissue. We believe our product candidates have the potential to unlock the full therapeutic benefits of modulating the TGF-β superfamily and provide disease-modifying benefit to patients.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Director of Quality Operations is responsible for providing quality oversight to all manufacturing operations in support of clinical development and commercial products, including but not limited to, Drug substance, Process Intermediates, and Drug Product(s). This role requires extensive interaction with Clinical Operations, Pharmaceutical Operations, Program and CMC project management, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and CMOs, to achieve sustainable compliance in GxP operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide quality oversight to all manufacturing operations in support of clinical development and commercial products. Ensure all manufacturing activities in support of Drug substance, Process Intermediates, and Drug Product(s), are conducted in accordance with internal company standards and in compliance with quality agreements.
* Formulating and administering policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) relating to the Quality Operations function and quality management system identifying opportunities for improvements.
* Ownership of real time batch record review and resolution of associated deviations prior to product disposition.
* Quality oversight of Deviations, Change Controls, CAPAs, etc., including those at the CMO sites.
* Developing and implementing appropriate quality training for the team.
* Assuring availability of all required documentation and support for the Annual Product Reviews
* Review of CMC sections for regulatory submissions to ensure accuracy and completeness. Participate in activities to assist with regulatory submissions, control strategy development and CMC strategy.
* Quality review and approval of Technology transfer protocols and final reports.
* Preparation for regulatory inspections at the CMO sites.
* Define, develop, and implement short-term and long-term strategies, goals, objectives, and tactics relating to the Quality Operations function and the quality management system.
* Review and recommend appropriate corrective action to ensure consistency with the Quality Operations function and the quality management system.
* Using incident and Corrective and Preventive Action ("CAPA") activities and processes to drive quality improvements and respond to process and service issues.

Institutional Funds Valuations (IVAS) is a fast growing department of CBRE VAS Dedicated to servicing the appraisal requirements of large institutional fund clients. The purpose of this position is to implement the CBRE Quality and Risk Management (QRM) function within IVAS.

This will include the enforcement, oversight and delivery of the QRM Framework as applicable to IVAS.

You will engage with clients and will be an integral part of both the IVAS department and the QRM team, with a passion for innovation and the desire to build something unique.

**What You'll Do:**

* The role is key to ensuring processes, procedures and the delivery of services are in line with regulatory, client and internal guidelines while also providing ongoing support for appraisers and IVAS management to manage risk.
* The QRM Director (IVAS) will predominantly provide approval of incoming Risk Assessments (RA) and participate in the appraisal review process, ensuring all appraisals are of high quality, comply with internal guidelines, uphold appraiser independence and are in line with regulatory and client standards, including USPAP requirements.

* Ensuring IVAS compliance with the CBRE VAS Appraisal Report Review Process, including personally completing reviews within the IVAS line of business within agreed turnaround time requirements.

* Following Risk Assessment procedures.

**Job Description:**
====================

**Overview:**

The Construction Quality Control Director is responsible for directing and managing the construction quality control program for major transportation and civil infrastructure projects. This position provides leadership and oversight for quality management systems, quality control activities, inspections, audits, documentation, nonconformance management, corrective actions, training, subcontractor quality requirements, and compliance with contract documents, project quality plans, federal, state, local, ISO 9001, and other applicable standards and requirements.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

  

**Quality Management System Leadership**

* Direct, develop, implement, administer, and maintain the Construction Quality Management System for the project, including the Project Quality Management Plan.
* Provide leadership and oversight for project quality control activities, quality processes, quality documentation, and quality performance expectations.
* Establish and enforce controlled systems that safeguard the integrity of project plans, construction operations, quality records, and compliant project execution.
* Ensure quality management activities are aligned with contract documents, company requirements, project requirements, and applicable quality standards.
Establish quality objectives, key performance indicators, and metrics; manage the quality control budget and resource plan; and report quality performance to executive and project leadership.  

  

**Field Quality Control, Inspections, and Audits**

* Oversee field quality control activities, inspections, testing documentation, quality reports, audits, and related quality records.
* Verify and oversee that construction site activities are performed in accordance with applicable codes, standards, specifications, contract documents, and project quality requirements.
* Hold authority to reject nonconforming work and to issue hold-point or stop-work decisions when quality, safety, or contract requirements are not met, independent of production pressures.
* Develop and implement quality trainings and perform quality control audits for the project, subcontractors, and related project teams.
* Oversee materials testing programs and coordinate with certified testing laboratories and third-party inspectors.
Lead quality-related meetings with project teams, the owner, and subcontractors, and provide direction, follow-up, and technical support as needed.  

  

**Compliance, Documentation, and Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with contract documents, the Project Quality Management Plan, and federal, state, local, ISO 9001, and other applicable regulatory laws and standards.
* Maintain and report quality management system records as required by the Project Quality Management Plan and company corporate requirements.  Oversee the preparation, review, and audit of quality reports, quality records, audit results, inspection documentation, test results, and other quality performance information.
* Ensure relevant quality control documentation is distributed to site subcontractors, project teams, and other stakeholders.
Serve as the primary quality liaison with the owner, GDOT and agency representatives, and thirdparty inspectors, including audit findings, work acceptance, and final quality closeout and turnover documentation.  

  

**Nonconformance, Corrective Actions, and Subcontractor Quality Support**

* Direct project-level nonconformance management and lead root cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive actions through closure.
* Jointly with construction and procurement departments, review contractual specifications for materials to be used on the project.
* Oversee evaluations of consultants and subcontractors as specified in the Project Quality Management Plan, and hold them accountable to project quality requirements.
Provide technical recommendations and practical solutions to support quality compliance, issue resolution, lessons learned, and continuous improvement throughout construction.  

  

**Leadership, Safety, and Team Support**

* Lead, staff, mentor, and evaluate quality control managers, inspectors, and technicians, setting performance expectations and developing their technical skills.
* Provide leadership to quality teams, construction teams, subcontractors, consultants, and project stakeholders through example, direction, coordination, and sharing of knowledge and skills.  Partner with project leadership, construction, procurement, engineering, document control, safety, and other departments to ensure quality needs are being met.

Other unlisted duties will be assigned.  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of ten (10) years of progressive quality control management experience in construction or similar roles required, including supervision of quality control managers, inspectors, and technicians, preferably on large highway, bridge, paving, utility relocation, heavy civil, transportation, or related infrastructure projects.
* Experience developing and maintaining project quality management plans, quality systems, audits, inspections, reports, documentation, and corrective action processes required.
* Knowledge of construction quality control requirements, contract documents, specifications, drawings, ISO 9001, regulatory standards, testing, inspections, and documentation practices required.
* Experience managing quality control budgets and resources and working directly with owners, GDOT and agency representatives, and third-party inspectors and testing laboratories required.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, SharePoint, and document control systems; applicable quality and construction certifications preferred.
Strong ability to interpret construction documents and project records, with effective communication, reporting, leadership, organization, problem-solving, decision-making, attention to detail, safety, compliance, integrity, and ethics.

**Description:**

The Director, Quality – External Manufacturing leads the External Quality team responsible for quality oversight of Amneal's network of 50+ external manufacturers, including contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract packagers, contract testing laboratories, and API/critical material suppliers across oral solid dose, injectables, and complex products. The role ensures that products manufactured or tested externally meet Amneal's quality standards, approved regulatory filings, and applicable cGMP requirements, and that Amneal's Quality Unit retains full accountability for outsourced operations. Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Quality, the Director leads a team of External Quality Managers and QA Leads, each accountable for a defined set of partners / activities, and works closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Research & Development, and Regulatory Affairs.

**Essential Functions:**

* External Quality Leadership & Network Oversight - Lead quality oversight of 50+ external manufacturers, contract laboratories, and business partners. Establish a risk-based oversight model that tiers partners by product criticality, dosage form, regulatory history, and performance, and sets audit frequency, on-site presence, and review depth accordingly. Serve as the senior Quality decisionmaker for external manufacturing issues, product impact assessments, and escalations. Represent External Quality in management review and Quality Council forums.
* People Leadership - Lead, coach, and develop a team of External Quality Managers and QA Leads; assign partner portfolios and balance workload across 50+ sites. Build team capability in auditing, investigation review, risk assessment, and regulatory requirements. Develop and maintain SOPs, tools, and standard work for external quality oversight. Foster a culture of quality ownership, independent challenge, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Quality Agreements & Partner Qualification – Own the authoring, negotiation, approval, and periodic review of Quality Agreements. Lead quality due diligence, qualification, and approval of new partners; maintain the Approved Supplier List. Define and execute the CMO and contract laboratory audit program; ensure audit observations are tracked to effective closure. Lead quality disqualification and exit decisions for persistently non-compliant partners.
* Batch Disposition & Product Quality - Ensure timely, compliant review and disposition of externally manufactured batches against approved specifications and registered processes. Oversee review of executed batch records, CoAs, and release testing performed at contract laboratories. Ensure Annual Product Reviews incorporate complete and accurate CMO data and drive actions from trends. Oversee stability program commitments, OOS/OOT trending, and product quality complaints for externally manufactured products.
* Deviations, Investigations & CAPA - Ensure deviations, OOS/OOT results, and complaints at partner sites are investigated thoroughly and in a timely manner. Challenge root cause analyses for scientific rigor and identification of systemic contributors. Approve CAPAs and verify effectiveness; identify recurring issues across partners and drive network-wide preventive actions. Lead quality assessments for field alerts, recalls, and market actions involving external products.
Change Control & Regulatory Alignment - Govern partner-initiated and Amneal-initiated changes through change control, including product impact and regulatory reportability assessments. Partner with Regulatory Affairs to ensure changes are filed appropriately (CBE-0, CBE-30, PAS, annual report) and that partner operations remain aligned with approved ANDAs/NDAs. Provide quality oversight of technology transfers, site transfers, process validation, and new product launches at external sites.  

This position requires 30-40% travel both domestic and international.

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) Chemistry, biology, Pharmacy, engineering or other technical fields - Required
Master's degree (MS/MA) Chemistry, biology, Pharmacy, engineering or other technical fields - Preferred  

**Experience:**

* 15 years or more in QA, QC, Compliance in pharmaceutical manufacturing company.
* 5 years or more in External / CMO quality oversight.
Must have experience managing others.  

**Specialized Knowledge:**

* Demonstrated quality oversight of a large, multi-site CMO network across dosage forms (oral solids, sterile injectables, and/or complex generics).
* Expert knowledge of 21 CFR Parts 210/211, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP, ICH Q7/Q9/Q10, and FDA expectations for Quality Agreements and outsourced manufacturing.
* Experience hosting or supporting FDA inspections and leading 483 / Warning Letter remediation.
Strong background in investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control.  

The salary range for this position ranges from $205,000 - $236,000 per year. In addition, Amneal offers a short-term incentive opportunity, such as a bonus or performance-based award as well as a long-term incentive award, such as restricted stock units, with this position within the first 12 months. Amneal ranges reflect the Company’s good faith estimate of what Amneal reasonably believes that it will pay for said position at the time of the posting. Individual compensation will ultimately be determined based on a variety of relevant factors, including but not limited to, qualifications, experience, geographic location and other relevant skills.
  
  
At the heart of our Total Rewards commitment is a comprehensive, flexible and competitive benefits program for eligible positions that enables you to choose the plans and coverage that meet your personal needs. This includes above-market, diverse and robust health and insurance benefits to meet the varied needs of our employees as well as a significant 401(k) matching contribution to help our employees save for retirement. We also promote employee well-being with programs that help you enjoy your career alongside life’s many other commitments and opportunities.

  

Amneal is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact us at accommodations@amneal.com .
